title.zh: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 章宗四
title.raw: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 章宗四 Volume 12 Annals 12: Zhangzong 4

sentences.zh: 二月乙未朔，還宮。

translations.literal: Second month, on the yimo new moon, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yimo new moon, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以山東、河北旱，詔祈雨東、北二嶽。

translations.literal: On dingyou, because Shandong and Hebei suffered drought, an edict ordered rain prayers at the eastern and northern sacred peaks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou drought lay upon Shandong and Hebei; the court ordered rain prayers at the eastern and northern peaks.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命購豫王永成遺文。

translations.literal: On jihai he ordered the purchase of surviving writings of Prince Yongcheng of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he ordered the court to buy up the surviving writings of Prince Yongcheng of Yu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，始祭三皇、五帝、四王。

translations.literal: On gengxu sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns, Five Emperors, and Four Kings was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court first performed sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns, the Five Emperors, and the Four Kings.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔刺史，州郡無宣聖廟學者並增修之。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict told prefects that wherever a district lacked a temple of the Sage and a school, both were to be built up or repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict charged prefects: in any district without a Sage’s temple and school, build or repair both.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，日昏無光，大風毀宣陽門鴟尾。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingmao the sun dimmed without light; a great wind destroyed the owl-tail finial of Xuanyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, the sun went dull and lightless; a great wind tore the ridge-beast finial from Xuanyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命大興府祈雨。

translations.literal: On guiyou he ordered Daxing Prefecture to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he ordered Daxing Prefecture to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸太極宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin he visited Taiji Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he went to Taiji Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔定前代帝王合致祭者。

translations.literal: An edict fixed which former-dynasty emperors were fit to receive sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict settled which emperors of former dynasties were worthy of state sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏：「三皇、五帝、四王，已行三年一祭之禮。

translations.literal: The Department of State Affairs memorialized: “The Three Sovereigns, Five Emperors, and Four Kings already have the triennial sacrifice in place.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of State Affairs reported: “Sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns, Five Emperors, and Four Kings already follows the three-year cycle.

sentences.zh: 若夏太康，殷太甲、太戊、武丁，周成王、康王、宣王，漢高祖、文、景、武、宣、光武、明帝、章帝，唐高祖、文皇一十七君致祭為宜。

translations.literal: It is fitting to offer sacrifice to seventeen rulers: Xia’s Taikang; Yin’s Taojia, Taiwu, and Wuding; Zhou’s Kings Cheng, Kang, and Xuan; Han’s Founding Emperor, Emperors Wen, Jing, Wu, and Xuan, Guangwu, Ming, and Zhang; and Tang’s Founding Emperor and the Cultivated Emperor.”
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice is fitting for seventeen rulers: Taikang of Xia; Taojia, Taiwu, and Wuding of Yin; Kings Cheng, Kang, and Xuan of Zhou; the Han Founding Emperor and Emperors Wen, Jing, Wu, and Xuan, Guangwu, Ming, and Zhang; and Tang’s Founding Emperor and Cultivated Emperor.”

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ” Approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，祈雨於北郊。

translations.literal: On yiyou rain was prayed for at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou rain was prayed for at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，祈雨於社稷。

translations.literal: On renchen rain was prayed for at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen rain was prayed for at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 遼陽府判官民斜卯劉家以上書論列朝臣，削官一階，罷之。

translations.literal: Liaoyang assistant prefect Liu Jia of the Xie’ao clan, for a memorial sorting out and criticizing court ministers, had one rank of office stripped and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jia of the Xie’ao clan, assistant prefect of Liaoyang, memorialized to rank and criticize court ministers; one rank was stripped from him and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，詔定縣令以下考課法。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen an edict fixed the review law for magistrates and below.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, an edict fixed how magistrates and lesser officials were to be reviewed.

sentences.zh: 已亥，祈雨於太廟。

translations.literal: On jihai rain was prayed for at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai rain was prayed for at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚子，增定關防奸細格。

translations.literal: On gengzi regulations on passes to guard against spies were further fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the regulations on frontier passes against spies were tightened.

sentences.zh: 丙午，定衣服制。

translations.literal: On bingwu dress regulations were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the law on dress was fixed.

sentences.zh: 以祈雨，望祀嶽鎮海瀆於北郊。

translations.literal: Because of the rain prayers, peaks, town gods, and river deities were worshipped by distant sacrifice at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: For the rain prayers, sacred peaks, town gods, and river lords were given distant sacrifice at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，祈雨於社稷。

translations.literal: On guichou rain was prayed for at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou rain was prayed for at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以久旱，下詔責躬，求直言，避正殿，減膳撤樂，省禦廄馬，免旱災州縣徭役及今年夏稅。

translations.literal: On jiayin, because the drought had lasted long, an edict blamed himself, sought blunt counsel, avoided the main hall, cut food and withdrew music, reduced the imperial stables’ horses, and exempted corvée and this year’s summer tax in drought-stricken districts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, with drought unbroken, he issued a self-reproach edict, called for blunt counsel, left the main hall, ate sparingly and silenced music, thinned the imperial stables, and freed corvée and this summer’s tax in drought-hit districts.

sentences.zh: 遣使審系囚，理冤獄。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to examine prisoners in custody and settle wrongful cases.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to review prisoners and right wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，宰臣上表待罪。

translations.literal: On yimao the chief ministers submitted a table awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the chief ministers submitted a table offering to bear the blame.

sentences.zh: 詔答曰：「朕德有愆，上天示異。

translations.literal: The edict answered: “My virtue has faults; Heaven shows its warning.
translations.idiomatic: The reply edict said: “My virtue is at fault; Heaven has sent a sign.

sentences.zh: 卿等各趨乃職，思副朕懷。

translations.literal: Each of you should hurry to your duties and think how to meet my intent.”
translations.idiomatic: Each of you should hurry to your post and try to answer what I hope for.”

sentences.zh: 」戊午，以西上閣門使張偁等為故高麗國王王𧦬敕祭使，東上閣門使石愨等為高麗國王王韺慰問起複橫賜使。

translations.literal: ” On wuwu Western Upper Gate Commissioner Zhang Cheng and others were made imperial-sacrifice envoys to the late Goryeo king Wang Xi; Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner Shi Que and others were made envoys of condolence, inquiry on ending mourning, and lateral gifts to Goryeo king Wang Yin.
translations.idiomatic: ” On wuwu Western Upper Gate Commissioner Zhang Cheng and others were sent to conduct the imperial sacrifice for the late Goryeo king Wang Xi; Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner Shi Que and others were sent to Goryeo king Wang Yin with condolences, inquiry on the end of mourning, and lateral gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚申，祈雨於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengshen rain was prayed for at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen rain was prayed for at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，萬甯宮端門災。

translations.literal: On renxu Wanning Palace’s main gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu fire destroyed the main gate of Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，祈雨於北郊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yichou rain was prayed for at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou, rain was prayed for at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 有司請雩，詔三禱嶽瀆社稷宗廟，不雨，乃行之。

translations.literal: The relevant offices asked for a rain dance; an edict ruled that the peaks, rivers, soil-and-grain altars, and ancestral temple must be prayed to three times, and only if rain failed was the dance to be performed.
translations.idiomatic: The offices asked to hold a rain dance; an edict ordered three rounds of prayer at the sacred peaks, rivers, soil-and-grain altars, and ancestral temple, and only if rain still failed might the dance be held.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，平章政事徒單鎰、尚書左丞完顏匡罷。

translations.literal: On guiyou Grand Councilor Tuodan Yi and Left Vice Director Wanyan Kuang were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Grand Councilor Tuodan Yi and Left Vice Director Wanyan Kuang were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu rain fell.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，百官上表請禦正殿，複常儀。

translations.literal: On yihai the hundred officials memorialized asking him to hold court in the main hall and resume the regular rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the hundred officials memorialized, asking him to take the main hall and restore the usual ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，謝雨於宗廟。

translations.literal: On yiyou thanks for rain were offered at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou thanks for the rain were offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，報祀社稷。

translations.literal: On dinghai report-sacrifice was made at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai report-sacrifice was made at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 汰隨朝冗官。

translations.literal: Redundant officials attached to the court were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Superfluous officials kept on at court were cut.

sentences.zh: 定省令史關決公務，詭稱已稟，擅退六部、大理寺法狀及妄有所更易者罪。

translations.literal: Penalties were fixed for Secretariat clerks who decided public business, falsely claimed prior approval, on their own returned legal documents from the Six Ministries and the Court of Judicial Review, or rashly altered them.
translations.idiomatic: Penalties were fixed for Secretariat clerks who decided public business yet falsely claimed approval, who on their own sent back legal papers from the Six Ministries or the Court of Judicial Review, or who altered them without warrant.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，報謝嶽鎮海瀆。

translations.literal: On xinmao thanks were reported to the peaks, town gods, and river deities.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao thanks were reported to the sacred peaks, town gods, and river lords.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰朔，罷兼官俸給。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the renchen new moon, salary for concurrent offices was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renchen new moon, pay for holding concurrent posts was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，複行吏目移轉法。

translations.literal: On renyin the clerk-rank transfer law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the law on transferring clerk ranks was restored.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，始祭中溜。

translations.literal: On yisi sacrifice to the zhongliu was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi sacrifice to the zhongliu spirit was first performed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，罷惠、川、高三州，秀岩、灤陽、徽川、咸甯、金安、利民六縣，及北京宮苑使。

translations.literal: On wushen Hui, Chuan, and Gao prefectures, Xiuyan, Luanyang, Huichuan, Xianning, Jin’an, and Limin counties, and the Beijing palace-park commissioner were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court abolished Hui, Chuan, and Gao prefectures; Xiuyan, Luanyang, Huichuan, Xianning, Jin’an, and Limin counties; and the Beijing palace-park commissioner.

sentences.zh: 諸群牧提舉，居庸、紫荊、通會三關使，西北路鎮防十三千戶，諸路醫學博士。

translations.literal: Commissioners-in-chief of the herd offices, commissioners of the Juyong, Zijing, and Tonghui passes, the thirteen chiliarch households of the Northwestern Route frontier guard, and medical-doctor posts on every route.
translations.idiomatic: Also abolished were the herd commissioners-in-chief, commissioners of the Juyong, Zijing, and Tonghui passes, the thirteen chiliarch households of the Northwestern Route frontier guard, and route medical-doctor posts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，司天臺長行張冀進《天象傳》。

translations.literal: On renzi Chief Clerk Zhang Ji of the Directorate of Astronomy presented the Treatise on Celestial Appearances.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zhang Ji, chief clerk of the Directorate of Astronomy, presented the Treatise on Celestial Appearances.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，定申報盜賊制。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingmao regulations on reporting bandits were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingmao, the law on reporting bandits was fixed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On wuchen court offering was made at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he made court offering at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸望京甸。

translations.literal: On gengwu he visited the Jingwang enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went out to the Jingwang enclosure.

sentences.zh: 壬申，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On renshen he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷限錢法。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the limit-money law was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the limit-money law was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲申，改葬鎬王永中於威州。

translations.literal: On jiashen Prince Hao Yongzhong was reburied at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Prince Hao Yongzhong was reburied at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，大理丞姬端修、司直溫敦按帶論奏知大興府事紇石烈執中，坐所言不當，各削一官，罷職。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Dali Court vice-director Ji Duanxiu and investigating clerk Wendun Andai jointly memorialized impeaching Administrator of Daxing Heshenlie Zhizhong; for improper statements each was stripped one rank and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Dali Court Vice-Director Ji Duanxiu and Investigating Clerk Wendun Andai jointly impeached Daxing Administrator Heshenlie Zhizhong; for improper statements each lost one rank and was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以尚書右丞相宗浩為左丞相，右丞僕散揆為平章政事，參知政事孫即康為尚書右丞，御史大夫僕散端為左丞，吏部尚書獨吉思忠為參知政事。

translations.literal: On dingyou Right Chancellor of the Masters of Writing Zong Hao was made left chancellor; Right Vice Director Pusan Kuai was made grand councilor; Participation Councillor Sun Jikang was made right vice director; Censor-in-Chief Pusan Duan was made left vice director; and Minister of Personnel Dusi Jisi was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Right Chancellor Zong Hao became left chancellor; Right Vice Director Pusan Kuai became grand councilor; Participation Councillor Sun Jikang became right vice director; Censor-in-Chief Pusan Duan became left vice director; and Minister of Personnel Dusi Jisi became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔完顏綱、喬宇、宋元吉等編類陳言文字，其言涉宮庭，若大臣、省台、六部，各以類從，凡二千卷。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict ordered Wanyan Gang, Qiao Yu, Song Yuanji, and others to compile and classify memorials of submitted counsel; those touching the court, great ministers, the Secretariat and Censorate, or the Six Ministries were each to be arranged by category, two thousand scrolls in all.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he ordered Wanyan Gang, Qiao Yu, Song Yuanji, and others to compile memorials of blunt counsel; matters touching the court, great ministers, the Secretariat and Censorate, or the Six Ministries were to be sorted by category, two thousand scrolls in all.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以西京留守崇肅為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On xinchou Western Capital defender Chong Su was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Western Capital Defender Chong Su was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，更定閣門祗候出職格。

translations.literal: On guimao the standards for Inner Gate ushers’ exit posts were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the standards for Inner Gate ushers’ exit appointments were revised.

sentences.zh: 先是以天旱詔求直言。

translations.literal: Earlier, because of drought, an edict had sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, drought had led him to seek blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 至是尚書省奏：「河南府盧顯達、汝州王大材所陳，言涉不遜，請以情理切害論其罪。

translations.literal: Now the Secretariat memorialized: 「The submissions of Lu Xianda of Henan prefecture and Wang Dacai of Ruzhou involve disrespectful speech; please judge their crime under the statute for grave harm by reason and circumstance.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Secretariat reported: 「Lu Xianda of Henan prefecture and Wang Dacai of Ruzhou spoke disrespectfully; please punish them under the statute for grave harm by reason and circumstance.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍遍諭中外。

translations.literal: 」Approved, and the decision was announced throughout court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: 」The emperor agreed and had the decision proclaimed throughout court and realm.

sentences.zh: 命諸路學校生徒少者罷教授，止以本州、府文資官提控之。

translations.literal: Where route schools had few students, professors were abolished and only the civil official of the prefecture or circuit was to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: Where route schools had few pupils, teaching posts were abolished and only the local civil official of the prefecture or circuit was to supervise them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以安州軍事判官劉常言，諸按察司體訪不實，輒加糾劾者，從故出入人罪論，仍勒停。

translations.literal: On dingwei, on the memorial of Anzhou military judge Liu Chang, circuit surveillance commissioners who investigated without factual basis and then impeached were to be judged under the statute on intentional perversion of guilt and innocence and forced to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, on Anzhou military judge Liu Chang’s memorial, surveillance commissioners who investigated without factual basis and then impeached were to be punished as for deliberate perversion of guilt and innocence and forced to retire.

sentences.zh: 若事涉私曲，各從本法。

translations.literal: If the matter involved private bias, each was to be dealt with under the original law.
translations.idiomatic: Where private bias was involved, each case was to follow the original statute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以知真定府事完顏昌等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On yimao Wanyan Chang and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wanyan Chang and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸太極宮。

translations.literal: On dingsi he visited Taiji Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he visited Taiji Palace.

sentences.zh: 弛圍場遠地禁，縱民耕捕樵采。

translations.literal: Bans on distant hunting preserves were relaxed, and the people were allowed to farm, hunt, gather firewood, and cut brush.
translations.idiomatic: Bans on distant hunting preserves were relaxed so people could farm, hunt, gather firewood, and cut brush.

sentences.zh: 減教坊長行五十人，渤海教坊長行三十人，文繡署女工五十人。

translations.literal: The Music Office long-service corps was cut by fifty, the Bohai Music Office long-service corps by thirty, and the Embroidery Office female workers by fifty.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office long-service corps was reduced by fifty, the Bohai Music Office corps by thirty, and Embroidery Office female workers by fifty.

sentences.zh: 出宮女百六十人。

translations.literal: One hundred sixty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred sixty palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，天壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on gengshen, Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on gengshen, Heavenly Longevity Festival: envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，如薊州秋山。

translations.literal: On bingyin he went to Jizhou Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he went to Jizhou Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，定屯田戶自種及租佃法。

translations.literal: On renshen regulations were fixed for garrison households’ self-cultivation and tenancy.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the law on garrison households’ self-cultivation and tenancy was fixed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，定私鹼法。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu the private-salt law was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jiawu, the private-salt law was fixed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔親軍三十五以下令習《孝經》、《論語》。

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict ordered personal guards under thirty-five to study the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he ordered personal guards under thirty-five to study the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，至自秋山。

translations.literal: On guimao he returned from Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he returned from Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以提點尚衣局完顏燮為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On jiayin Superintendent of the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau Wanyan Xie was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wanyan Xie, superintendent of the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，以殿前右副都點檢烏林答毅等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingmao Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Wulindada Yi and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Wulindada Yi and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，木冰，凡三日。

translations.literal: On guiyou tree ice lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou trees were coated in ice for three days.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定收補承應人格。

translations.literal: On dingchou standards were fixed for recruiting attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou standards were fixed for recruiting attendants.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑朔，新平等縣虸蚄蟲生。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on jichou, locust worms appeared in Xinping and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon on jichou: locust worms appeared in Xinping and other counties.

sentences.zh: 己亥，左丞相宗浩等請上尊號。

translations.literal: On jihai Left Chancellor Zong Hao and others asked that an honorific title be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Left Chancellor Zong Hao and others asked him to accept an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，敕陝西、河南饑民所鬻男女，官為贖之。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict ordered that among famine victims in Shaanxi and Henan who had sold sons and daughters, the state was to ransom them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he ordered the state to ransom sons and daughters sold by famine victims in Shaanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，百官再表乞受尊號。

translations.literal: On yimao the hundred officials again memorialized begging that an honorific title be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the hundred officials again begged that he accept an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己未朔，大雪。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, on jiwei the new moon, heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: In year five, on the jiwei new moon of the first spring month, heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 庚申，謁衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On gengshen he visited Yansqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he visited Yansqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸太極宮。

translations.literal: On yichou he visited Taiji Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he visited Taiji Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，如光春宮春水。

translations.literal: On dingmao he went to the spring waters at Guangchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he went to the spring waters at Guangchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬申，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On renshen he offered at Yansqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he offered at Yansqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔有司：「自泰和三年郡縣三經行幸、民嘗供億者，賜今年租稅之半。

translations.literal: On yihai he ordered the relevant offices: 「From Taihe year three, prefectures and counties that three times supplied imperial tours shall be granted half this year’s rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he told the relevant offices: 「From Taihe year three, prefectures and counties that three times bore the costs of imperial tours shall receive half this year’s rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，次霸州。

translations.literal: 」On dingchou he halted at Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingchou he halted at Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 調山東、河北軍夫改治漕渠。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers from Shandong and Hebei armies were mobilized to repair the transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée from Shandong and Hebei armies was mobilized to repair the transport canal.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑朔，諭按察司：「近制以鎮靜而知大體為稱職，苛細而暗於大體為不稱。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on jichou, he instructed circuit surveillance commissions: 「The recent rule praised those who were calm and grasped the larger pattern as competent, and those who were nitpicking and blind to the larger pattern as incompetent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jichou new moon, he told circuit surveillance commissions: 「The recent rule praised calm officials who grasped the larger pattern as competent, and nitpicking officials blind to it as incompetent.

sentences.zh: 由是各路按察以因循為事，莫思舉刺，郡縣以貪黜相尚，莫能畏戢。

translations.literal: Because of this, route surveillance everywhere treated inaction as their business and never thought to investigate and impeach, while prefectures and counties vied in greed and dismissal and none could be restrained.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, surveillance officials everywhere treated inaction as their duty and never thought to investigate, while prefectures and counties vied in greed and dismissal and none could be restrained.

sentences.zh: 自今若糾察得實，民無冤滯，能使一路鎮靜者為稱職。

translations.literal: From now on, if investigation and impeachment prove true, the people have no wrongs left unresolved, and one can keep a whole circuit calm, that is competence.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, if investigation and impeachment prove true, the people have no unresolved wrongs, and a whole circuit is kept calm, that counts as competence.

sentences.zh: 其或煩紊使民不得伸訴者，是為曠廢。

translations.literal: If officials are so troublesome and disorderly that the people cannot obtain redress, that is dereliction.
translations.idiomatic: If officials are so troublesome and disorderly that the people cannot obtain redress, that is dereliction.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，定鞫勘官受飲宴者罪。

translations.literal: 」On guisi penalties were fixed for interrogating officials who accepted banquets.
translations.idiomatic: 」On guisi penalties were fixed for interrogating officials who accepted banquets.

sentences.zh: 己亥，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On jihai he went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，制盜用及偽造都門契者罪，視宮城門減一等。

translations.literal: On jiayin penalties were fixed for stealing use of and forging capital-gate passes, one grade lighter than for palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin penalties were set for stealing or forging capital-gate passes, one grade below those for palace gates.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，還宮。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengshen, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，更定兩稅輸限。

translations.literal: On guihai the delivery deadlines for the two taxes were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the payment deadlines for the two taxes were revised.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宋兵入秦川界。

translations.literal: On yichou Song troops entered the Qin River circuit border.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Song troops crossed into the Qin River circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚午，親王、百官請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: On gengwu imperial princes and the hundred officials asked to give him an honorific title; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu imperial princes and the hundred officials asked to give him an honorific title; he refused.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諭有司，進士名有犯孔子諱者避之，仍著為令。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he instructed the relevant offices that where a jinshi examinee’s name tabooed Confucius it should be avoided, and this was written into ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he told the relevant offices that jinshi candidates whose names tabooed Confucius must avoid the taboo, and had the rule written into law.

sentences.zh: 命給米諸寺，自

translations.literal: He ordered grain given to the various temples, from
translations.idiomatic: He ordered grain issued to the temples, from

sentences.zh: 十月十五日至次年正月十五日作糜以食貧民。

translations.literal: the fifteenth of the tenth month to the fifteenth of the first month of the following year, to make congee to feed the poor.
translations.idiomatic: the fifteenth of the tenth month through the fifteenth of the first month of the next year, to cook congee for the poor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷獄空錢。

translations.literal: On wuyin the empty-prison fee was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the empty-prison fee was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宋失入鞏州來遠鎮。

translations.literal: On xinsi Song forces mistakenly entered Laiyuan town in Gong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Song forces mistakenly entered Laiyuan town in Gong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐州得宋諜者，言韓侂胄屯兵鄂、嶽，將謀北侵。

translations.literal: Tang prefecture captured a Song spy who said Han Tuozhou was massing troops at E and Yue and planned a northern invasion.
translations.idiomatic: Tang prefecture captured a Song spy who reported that Han Tuozhou was concentrating troops at E and Yue and intended to invade north.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子朔，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: Fourth month, new moon on wuzi: he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the wuzi new moon, he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命樞密院移文宋人，依誓約撤新兵，毋縱入境。

translations.literal: On guisi he ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to send a dispatch to Song to withdraw new troops according to the covenant and not allow them to cross the border.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to notify Song to pull back new troops under the treaty and not let them cross the border.

sentences.zh: 壬子，定隨路轉運司及府官每季檢視庫物法。

translations.literal: On renzi law was fixed for circuit transport commissioners and prefectural officials to inspect storehouse goods every quarter.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi regulations were set requiring circuit transport commissioners and prefectural officials to inspect storehouse goods each quarter.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，以平章政事僕散揆為河南宣撫使，籍諸道兵以備宋。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi, Grand Councilor Pusan Kui was made Henan Pacification Commissioner and troops from all circuits were registered to guard against Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Grand Councilor Pusan Kui was appointed Henan Pacification Commissioner and troops from every circuit were mustered against Song.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔定遼東邑社人數。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict fixed the population count of Liaodong village communities.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict fixed the household rolls of Liaodong village communities.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，更定檢、知法勒留格。

translations.literal: On wuyin the law on retention under inspection and cognizance was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the rules on retention under inspection and cognizance were revised.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如慶甯宮。

translations.literal: On jimao he went to Qingning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he went to Qingning Palace.

sentences.zh: 制司屬丞凡遭父母喪止給卒哭假，為永制。

translations.literal: It was decreed that bureau subordinate assistant commissioners who suffered parental bereavement receive only mourning leave ending at zu ku, as a permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: A permanent rule was set that bureau subordinate assistant commissioners in parental mourning receive only leave through zu ku.

sentences.zh: 甲申，宋人入漣水縣。

translations.literal: On jiashen Song forces entered Lianshui county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Song forces entered Lianshui county.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，複漣水縣。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuzi: Lianshui county was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, Lianshui county was recovered.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，制定本朝婚禮。

translations.literal: On dingyou this dynasty’s marriage rites were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the dynasty’s marriage rites were established.

sentences.zh: 更定鬻米麵入外界法。

translations.literal: The law on selling rice and flour into foreign territories was revised.
translations.idiomatic: The law on selling rice and flour across the border was revised.

sentences.zh: 己酉，制鎮防軍逃亡致邊事失錯、陷敗戶口者罪。

translations.literal: On jiyou penalties were fixed for frontier-garrison deserters who caused border mishaps and loss of households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou penalties were set for deserters from frontier garrisons who caused border failures and ruined households.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔拜禮不依本朝者罰。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict penalized those whose bowing rites did not follow this dynasty’s custom.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict punished those whose bows did not follow the dynasty’s rites.

sentences.zh: 召諸大臣問備宋之策，皆以設備養惡為言。

translations.literal: He summoned the chief ministers to ask strategy against Song; all spoke of building defenses while indulging Song’s provocations.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned the chief ministers to ask how to prepare against Song; all urged strengthening defenses while tolerating Song’s provocations.

sentences.zh: 上以南北和好四十餘載，民不知兵，不忍先發。

translations.literal: The emperor said north and south had been at peace more than forty years, the people knew nothing of war, and he could not bear to strike first.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said that north and south had been at peace for more than forty years, the people were unused to war, and he could not bear to strike first.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰，如錦屏山。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wuchen: he went to Jinping Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuchen, he went to Jinping Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On renshen court tribute was offered at Yanging Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he offered court tribute at Yanging Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宣撫使揆奏定奸細罪賞法。

translations.literal: On yihai Pacification Commissioner Kui memorialized fixing reward-and-punishment law for spies.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Pacification Commissioner Kui submitted rules for rewards and penalties on spies.

sentences.zh: 丙子，定圍場誤射中人罪。

translations.literal: On bingzi penalties were fixed for shooting someone by mistake in the hunting enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi penalties were set for accidentally shooting someone in the hunting park.

sentences.zh: 壬午，招諸縣盜賊多所選注巡尉。

translations.literal: On renwu patrol inspectors and constables were specially recruited and posted in counties with many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu patrol inspectors and constables were specially selected and posted in counties with heavy banditry.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，詔罷宣撫司。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinmao: an edict abolished the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, an edict abolished the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 時宋殿帥敦倪、濠州守將田俊邁誘虹縣民蘇貴等為間，河南將臣亦屢縱諜，往往利俊邁之賂，反為遊說。

translations.literal: At the time Song palace guard commander Dun Ni and Shou prefecture defender Tian Junmai induced Su Gui and others of Hong county as agents; Henan commanders also repeatedly sent out spies, often taking bribes from Junmai and in turn acting as his advocates.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Song palace guard commander Dun Ni and Shou prefecture defender Tian Junmai had induced Su Gui and others of Hong county as agents; Henan commanders also kept releasing spies, often bribed by Junmai and then pleading his case.

sentences.zh: 皆言宋之增戍，本虞他盜，及聞行台之建，益畏懾不敢去備。

translations.literal: All said Song’s reinforcement had originally been to guard against other bandits, but hearing that a mobile headquarters had been set up they grew more fearful and dared not reduce their defenses.
translations.idiomatic: All claimed Song’s troop buildup had first been against other raiders, but that once they heard a field headquarters was established they grew more afraid and would not ease their guard.

sentences.zh: 且兵皆白丁，自裹糧Я，窮蹙饑疫，死者十二三，由是中外信之。

translations.literal: Moreover the troops were all raw conscripts carrying their own grain rations; distressed by hunger and plague, two or three tenths died, whereupon court and country alike believed it.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the soldiers were all levied civilians carrying their own rations; worn down by hunger and plague, two or three in ten died, and thereafter everyone at court and beyond believed it.

sentences.zh: 宣撫司以宋三省、樞密院及盱眙軍牒來上，又皆鐫點邊臣為辭。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission presented dispatches from Song’s Three Departments, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Xuyi army, all likewise using reproaches of frontier officials as their pretext.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commission forwarded dispatches from Song’s Three Departments, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Xuyi army, each also blaming frontier officials in its wording.

sentences.zh: 宣撫使揆因請罷司，從之。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Kui therefore asked to abolish the commission; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Kui then asked to abolish the commission; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 揆又奏罷臨洮、德順、秦、鞏新置弓箭手。

translations.literal: Kui also memorialized abolishing the newly established archer troops at Lintao, Deshun, Qin, and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Kui also asked to disband the newly raised archer units at Lintao, Deshun, Qin, and Gong.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙卯朔，罷典衛司。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, new moon on yimao: the Palace Guard Directorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the yimao new moon, the Palace Guard Directorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，還宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申朔，天壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on jiashen: Heavenly Longevity Day; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiashen new moon, Heavenly Longevity Day; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，西北方黑雲間有赤氣如火色，次及西南、正南、東南路方皆赤，有白氣貫其中，至中夜，赤氣滿天，四更乃散。

translations.literal: On wuzi, between black clouds in the northwest there was red vapor like fire; it next reached the southwest, due south, and southeast, all red, with white vapor running through it; by midnight red vapor filled the sky and only at the fourth watch did it disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi red vapor like flame appeared between black clouds in the northwest, then spread through the southwest, south, and southeast, all red, pierced by white vapor; by midnight the sky was full of red vapor, which cleared only at the fourth watch.

sentences.zh: 以河南路統軍使紇石烈子仁等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Henan circuit commander He Shilie Ziren and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Henan circuit commander He Shilie Ziren and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宋兵三百攻比陽寺莊，副巡檢阿雷根寺家奴死之。

translations.literal: On wuxu three hundred Song troops attacked Biyang temple manor; deputy patrol inspector A’leigen’s temple household slave died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu three hundred Song troops attacked Biyang temple manor; the temple household slave of Deputy Patrol Inspector A’leigen was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宋人焚黃澗，虜巡檢高顥。

translations.literal: On jiachen Song forces burned Huangjian and captured patrol inspector Gao Hao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Song forces burned Huangjian and captured Patrol Inspector Gao Hao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，以刑部員外郎李元忠為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengshen: Li Yuanzhong, vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on gengshen, Li Yuanzhong, vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宋人襲比陽。

translations.literal: On dingchou Song forces raided Biyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Song forces raided Biyang.

sentences.zh: 唐州軍事判官撒睹死之。

translations.literal: Tang prefecture military adjudge Sado died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Tang prefecture military adjudge Sado died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，宋人入內鄉，攻洛南之固縣，商州司獄壽祖追至丹河，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiyou: Song forces entered Neixiang and attacked Gu county in Luonan; Shangzhou prison inspector Shouzu pursued to the Dan River and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, Song forces entered Neixiang and attacked Gu county in Luonan; Shangzhou prison inspector Shouzu pursued them to the Dan River and routed them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，乙太常卿趙之傑等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On jichou Zhao Zhijie, Minister of Rites, and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhao Zhijie, minister of rites, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，山東闕食，賜錢三萬貫以賑之。

translations.literal: On guisi Shandong lacked food; thirty thousand strings of cash were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, because Shandong lacked grain, thirty thousand strings of cash were granted for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 乙未，初定武舉格。

translations.literal: On yiwei standards for the military examination were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei standards for the military examination were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔山東、陝西帥臣訓練士卒，以備非常。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict ordered military governors of Shandong and Shaanxi to drill troops against emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court ordered the military governors of Shandong and Shaanxi to train their soldiers against emergencies.

sentences.zh: 仍以銀十五萬兩分給邊帥，募民偵伺。

translations.literal: One hundred fifty thousand taels of silver were also distributed among frontier commanders to hire civilians for reconnaissance.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred fifty thousand taels of silver were also allotted to frontier commanders to hire civilians for scouting.

sentences.zh: 複遣武衛軍副都指揮使完顏太平、殿前右衛副將軍蒲察阿裏赴邊，伺其入，伏兵掩之。

translations.literal: Wanyan Taiping, deputy commander of the Martial Guard Army, and Pucha Ali, deputy general of the Right Palace Guard, were again sent to the frontier to watch for incursions and ambush with hidden troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Taiping, deputy commander of the Martial Guard Army, and Pucha Ali, deputy general of the Right Palace Guard, were again dispatched to the border to watch for enemy entry and set ambushes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大雪，免朝參。

translations.literal: On wuxu heavy snow fell; court attendance was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu heavy snow fell and court attendance was excused.

sentences.zh: 己亥，更定宮中局、署承應收補格。

translations.literal: On jihai regulations were revised for recruitment and appointment of palace bureau and office attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai rules were revised governing recruitment and appointment of attendants in palace bureaus and offices.

sentences.zh: 宋吳曦擁眾興元，欲窺關、隴，皇甫斌益募兵擾淮北，所掠即以與之，使自為戰。

translations.literal: Song's Wu Xi gathered forces at Xingyuan intending to probe Guan and Long; Huangfu Bin increasingly recruited troops to harass north of the Huai, giving them whatever they plundered so they would fight on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Song's Wu Xi massed troops at Xingyuan with an eye on Guan and Long; Huangfu Bin kept raising more men to raid north of the Huai and let them keep what they seized so they would fight for themselves.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸未朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, on guawei the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year six, on the guawei new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys arrived from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，宋使陳克俊等朝辭。

translations.literal: On dinghai Song envoys Chen Kejun and others took leave after audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Song envoys Chen Kejun and others were received in farewell audience.

sentences.zh: 遣御史大夫孟鑄就館諭克俊等曰：「大定初，世宗皇帝許宋世為侄國，朕遵守遺法，和好至今。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Meng Zhu was sent to their lodging to instruct Kejun and the others: "At the beginning of Dading, Emperor Shizong allowed Song's emperor status as a nephew-state; I have upheld the testamentary law and kept peace until now.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Meng Zhu was sent to their quarters to tell Kejun and the others: "At the start of Dading, Emperor Shizong granted Song the standing of a nephew-state; I have followed his testament and kept the peace until now.

sentences.zh: 豈意爾國屢有盜賊犯我邊境，以此遣大臣宣撫河南軍民。

translations.literal: Who would have thought your state would repeatedly have bandits violate our frontier — for this I sent great ministers to pacify the army and people of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Yet your state has repeatedly let bandits raid our borders, and for that I sent high ministers to pacify the armies and people of Henan.

sentences.zh: 及得爾國有司公移，稱已罷黜邊臣，抽去兵卒，朕方以天下為度，不介小嫌，遂罷宣撫司。

translations.literal: When your state's offices sent official communications saying frontier ministers had been removed and troops withdrawn, I took the empire as my measure, made nothing of small grievances, and abolished the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: When your offices sent formal notices that frontier officials had been dismissed and troops pulled back, I looked to the empire as a whole, set aside petty suspicions, and abolished the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 未幾，盜賊甚于前日，比來群臣屢以爾國渝盟為言，朕惟和好歲久，委曲涵容。

translations.literal: Before long bandits were worse than before; lately ministers have repeatedly spoken of your state's breach of alliance — I alone, because peace has lasted so long, have borne and swallowed it.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the bandits were worse than ever; lately my ministers have again and again said your state has broken the alliance — I alone, because peace has lasted so many years, have swallowed the affront.

sentences.zh: 恐侄宋皇帝或未詳知。

translations.literal: I fear the Song nephew-emperor may not know the details.
translations.idiomatic: I fear the Song nephew-emperor may not know the full story.

sentences.zh: 若依前不息，臣下或複有雲，朕雖兼愛生靈，事亦豈能終已。

translations.literal: If as before this does not cease, or my subjects again raise the matter, though I cherish all living beings, how can the affair end?
translations.idiomatic: If things go on as before, or my subjects again press the point, though I love all the people, how can the matter simply end?

sentences.zh: 卿等歸國，當以朕意具言之汝主。

translations.literal: When you return home you should fully report my meaning to your sovereign."
translations.idiomatic: When you return, you must report my meaning in full to your sovereign."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，朝享于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On xinmao he performed court sacrifice at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he offered court sacrifice at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，宋興元守將吳曦遣兵圍抹熟龍堡，部將蒲鮮長安擊走之，斬其將。

translations.literal: On bingshen Song Xingyuan garrison commander Wu Xi sent troops to besiege Mosulong Fort; subordinate commander Puxian Chang'an drove them off and beheaded their general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wu Xi, Song commander at Xingyuan, sent troops to besiege Mosulong Fort; subordinate commander Puxian Chang'an beat them back and beheaded their general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，更定保伍法。

translations.literal: On xinchou the mutual-security-group law was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the mutual-security-group law was revised.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，始以沿河縣官兼管勾漕河事，州、府官兼提控。

translations.literal: On guimao county officials along rivers were first made to oversee grain-transport canal affairs concurrently; prefectural officials were also to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao county magistrates along waterways were first ordered to handle grain-canal affairs concurrently, with prefectural officials placed in overall charge.

sentences.zh: 丁未，如春水。

translations.literal: On dingwei he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he went to the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宋人入撒牟穀。

translations.literal: On gengxu Song forces entered Samugu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Song troops entered Samugu Valley.

sentences.zh: 陝西統軍判官完顏摑剌、鞏州兵馬鈐轄完顏七斤約宋西和州守將會境上。

translations.literal: Shaanxi army supervisor Wanyan Wala and Gongzhou military superintendent Wanyan Qijin arranged to meet the Song Xinghe prefecture garrison commander at the border.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi army supervisor Wanyan Wala and Gongzhou military superintendent Wanyan Qijin arranged to meet the Song garrison commander of Xihe prefecture on the border.

sentences.zh: 俄伏發，為所襲，木波部長趙彥雄等七人死焉。

translations.literal: Suddenly ambushers sprang up; they were attacked; seven including Mubo chief Zhao Yanxiong died.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly hidden troops struck; they were ambushed, and seven men including Mubo chief Zhao Yanxiong were killed.

sentences.zh: 摑剌馬陷淖中，中流矢，七斤僅以身免。

translations.literal: Wala's horse sank in mire; he was struck by an arrow; Qijin barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Wala's horse sank in bog; he was hit by an arrow, and Qijin barely escaped alive.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，禦史中丞孟鑄言：「提刑改為按察司，又差官覆察，權削而望輕，非便。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiaxu, Vice Censor-in-chief Meng Zhu said: "Changing the intendant of punishments to the surveillance commission, then sending officials again to re-inspect, weakens authority and prestige — it is not beneficial.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, Vice Censor-in-chief Meng Zhu said: "When the intendant of punishments was changed to the surveillance commission and officials were again sent to re-inspect, authority was cut and standing lowered — that is not advantageous.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事賈鉉曰：「按察司既差監察體訪，複遣官覆察之，誠為繁冗。

translations.literal: Vice-grand-councillor Jia Xuan said: "The surveillance commission already dispatches investigating inspectors, then sending officials again to re-inspect is truly redundant.
translations.idiomatic: Participation councillor Jia Xuan said: "The surveillance commission already sends investigating inspectors; dispatching another officer to re-inspect is truly burdensome.

sentences.zh: 請自今差監察時即遣官與俱，更不覆察。

translations.literal: From now when inspectors are dispatched, send an official with them; do not re-inspect again.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, when inspectors are sent out, let an official go with them and do away with re-inspection.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，尚書省奏，商州刺史烏古論袞州請賻押軍官與南兵戰沒者，又奏遷右振肅蒲察五斤官，皆從之。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiawu, the Ministry of Revenue reported: Shangzhou prefect Wugulun Gunzhou requested burial gifts for officers who died fighting southern troops; also reported transfer of Right Zhengsu Pucha Wujin — all approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiawu, the Ministry of Revenue reported that Shangzhou Prefect Wugulun Gunzhou had asked burial gifts for escort officers killed fighting southern troops, and also recommended promoting Right Zhengsu Pucha Wujin — all approved.

sentences.zh: 明昌初，五斤嘗為奉禦，出使山東，至河間，以百姓饑，輒移提刑司開倉賑之，還具以聞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Mingchang, Wujin had been a palace attendant; on mission to Shandong he reached Hejian and, seeing the people starving, moved the intendant commission to open granaries for relief, then reported fully on return.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Mingchang, Wujin had served as palace attendant; sent to Shandong he reached Hejian, saw the people starving, and at once ordered the intendant commission to open granaries for relief, then reported everything on his return.

sentences.zh: 上初甚悅。

translations.literal: At first the emperor was very pleased.
translations.idiomatic: At first the emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 太傅徒單克寧言：「陛下始親大政，不宜假近侍人權，乞正專擅之罪。

translations.literal: Grand Mentor Tushan Keming said: "Your Majesty has only lately taken direct charge of government; you should not lend authority to close attendants — I beg that the crime of usurping power be formally punished.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Mentor Tushan Keming said: "Your Majesty has only lately assumed personal rule; you ought not grant power to nearby attendants — I ask that the offense of acting on your own authority be punished.

sentences.zh: 」詔杖之二十。

translations.literal: An edict ordered twenty strokes of the staff.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him beaten twenty strokes.

sentences.zh: 克寧又以為言，乃罷之。

translations.literal: Keming spoke again, and Wujin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When Keming spoke again, Wujin was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 後上思之，由泰州都軍召為振肅。

translations.literal: Later the emperor thought of him and summoned him from Taizhou army commander to Right Zhengsu.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor remembered him and recalled him from Taizhou army commander to Right Zhengsu.

sentences.zh: 己亥，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On jihai he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，敕尚書省：「祖父母、父母無人侍養，而子孫遠遊至經歲者，甚傷風化，雖舊有徒二年之罪，似涉太輕。

translations.literal: An edict to the Ministry of Revenue: "When grandparents and parents lack anyone to attend them and descendants travel far for a full year or more, it gravely injures customary morality; though the old penalty was two years' penal servitude, it seems too light.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Ministry of Revenue: "Where grandparents and parents have no one to care for them while descendants travel far away for a year or more, custom is gravely harmed; though the old penalty was two years' penal servitude, it seems too light.

sentences.zh: 其考前律，再議以聞。

translations.literal: Examine prior statutes and deliberate again for report."
translations.idiomatic: Review earlier statutes and deliberate again before reporting."

sentences.zh: 」己酉，宋人攻靈璧，南京按察使行部至縣，匿民捨得免。

translations.literal: On jiyou Song forces attacked Lingbi; the Nanjing surveillance commissioner was on circuit in the county and hid in a civilian house to escape.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Song troops attacked Lingbi; the Nanjing surveillance commissioner was touring the county and escaped by hiding in a commoner's house.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，宋人圍壽春。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingchen, Song forces besieged Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingchen, Song forces besieged Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 壽春告急於亳，同知防禦使賢聖奴將步騎六百赴之，乃退。

translations.literal: Shouchun sent urgent word to Bo; associate defense commissioner Xiansheng Nu led six hundred infantry and cavalry to relieve it, and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shouchun sent urgent word to Bo; Associate Defense Commissioner Xiansheng Nu led six hundred foot and horse to the rescue, and the besiegers withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書省奏：「河南統軍司言，統軍使紇石烈子仁等遣嚴整、閻忠、周秀輩入襄陽。

translations.literal: On guihai the Ministry of Revenue reported: "The Henan Army Command states that army commander Heshilie Ziren and others sent Yan Zheng, Yan Zhong, Zhou Xiu, and others into Xiangyang
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Ministry of Revenue reported: "The Henan Army Command says army commander Heshilie Ziren and others sent Yan Zheng, Yan Zhong, Zhou Xiu, and the like into Xiangyang

sentences.zh: 覘敵陰事。

translations.literal: to spy on the enemy's secret affairs.
translations.idiomatic: to spy on the enemy's secret plans.

sentences.zh: 還言皇甫斌遣兵四萬規取鄧，以我叛人田元為鄉導，三萬人規取唐，以張真、張勝為鄉導，俱授統領官，故不敢無備。

translations.literal: They returned reporting Huangfu Bin was sending forty thousand troops to take Deng, with our defector Tian Yuan as guide; thirty thousand to take Tang, with Zhang Zhen and Zhang Sheng as guides — all granted command posts — so we dare not be unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: They returned saying Huangfu Bin would send forty thousand men to seize Deng, using our defector Tian Yuan as guide, and thirty thousand to seize Tang with Zhang Zhen and Zhang Sheng as guides, all given command — so we dare not be caught unready.

sentences.zh: 乃聚鄭、汝、陽翟之兵于昌武，以南京副留守兼兵馬副都總管紇石烈毅統之，聚亳、陳、襄邑之兵於歸德，以河南路副統軍徒單鐸統之，而自以所部兵駐汴。

translations.literal: Troops of Zheng, Ru, and Yangdi were gathered at Changwu under Nanjing deputy commissioner and deputy army chief Heshilie Yi; troops of Bo, Chen, and Xiangyi at Guide under Henan Route deputy army commander Tushan Duo; he himself encamped at Bian with his own division.
translations.idiomatic: Forces from Zheng, Ru, and Yangdi were massed at Changwu under Nanjing Deputy Commissioner and Deputy Army Chief Heshilie Yi; forces from Bo, Chen, and Xiangyi at Guide under Henan Route Deputy Army Commander Tushan Duo; and he himself stationed his own troops at Bian.

sentences.zh: 及擬山東東、西路軍七千付統軍紇石烈執中駐大名，河北東、西路軍萬七千屯河南，皆給以馬，有老弱者易其人。

translations.literal: Seven thousand troops of Shandong East and West circuits were assigned to army commander Heshilie Zhizhong at Daming; seventeen thousand of Hebei East and West circuits stationed in Henan — all given horses, with weak or elderly men replaced.
translations.idiomatic: Seven thousand men from Shandong East and West circuits were placed under army commander Heshilie Zhizhong at Daming, and seventeen thousand from Hebei East and West circuits were posted in Henan, all supplied with horses and with the old or weak replaced.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: All approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宋人攻天水界，乙丑，入東柯穀，部將劉鐸戰敗之。

translations.literal: On jiazi Song forces attacked the Tianshui border; on yichou they entered Eastern Ke Valley; subordinate commander Liu Duo defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Song troops struck the Tianshui frontier; on yichou they entered Eastern Ke Valley, and subordinate commander Liu Duo beat them back.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔平章政事僕散揆領行省于汴，許以便宜從事。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict ordered Grand Councilor Pusan Kui to take charge of the Branch Secretariat at Bian, with authority to act at his discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the court ordered Grand Councilor Pusan Kui to head the Branch Secretariat at Bian and granted him discretionary powers.

sentences.zh: 升諸道統軍司為兵馬都統府，以山東東、西路統軍使紇石烈執中為山東西路兵馬都統使，定海軍節度使、副都統軍使完顏撒剌副之，陝西統軍使充為陝西五路兵馬都統使，通遠軍節度使胡沙、知臨洮府事石抹仲溫副之。

translations.literal: Circuit Army Commands in every route were raised to Cavalry-and-Infantry Grand Unified Commands; Shandong East and West Route army commander Heshilie Zhizhong was made commander of the Shandong East and West Cavalry-and-Infantry Grand Unified Command, with Dinghai Army jiedushi and deputy unified army commander Wanyan Sala as his deputy; Shaanxi army commander Chong was made commander of the Shaanxi Five Routes Cavalry-and-Infantry Grand Unified Command, with Tongyuan Army jiedushi Hu Sha and Lintao prefectural intendant Shimo Zhongwen as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit Army Command was promoted to a Cavalry-and-Infantry Grand Unified Command; Shandong East and West Route army commander Heshilie Zhizhong became commander of the Shandong East and West grand unified command, with Dinghai Army jiedushi and deputy unified army commander Wanyan Sala as his deputy; Shaanxi army commander Chong became commander of the Shaanxi Five Routes grand unified command, with Tongyuan Army jiedushi Hu Sha and Lintao intendant Shimo Zhongwen as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 河南皆聽揆節制如故。

translations.literal: Henan remained under Kui’s direction as before.
translations.idiomatic: Henan continued under Kui’s command as before.

sentences.zh: 盡征諸道籍兵。

translations.literal: Registered troops from every circuit were fully mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Registered soldiers from every circuit were called up in full.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋吳曦攻來遠鎮之蘭家嶺。

translations.literal: On xinwei Wu Xi of Song attacked Lanjia Ridge at Laiyuan town.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wu Xi of Song attacked Lanjia Ridge at Laiyuan town.

sentences.zh: 丙子，招內外職官納馬各有數。

translations.literal: On bingzi officials inside and outside the court were ordered to contribute horses in fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi court and local officials were ordered to supply horses in set quotas.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宋人入新息、內鄉，又入泗州。

translations.literal: On dingchou Song forces entered Xinxi and Neixiang, and again entered Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Song troops entered Xinxi and Neixiang and again crossed into Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，入褒信。

translations.literal: On wuyin they entered Baoxin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin they entered Baoxin.

sentences.zh: 己卯，入虹縣。

translations.literal: On jimao they entered Hong county.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao they entered Hong county.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，入潁上。

translations.literal: On gengchen they entered Yingshang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen they entered Yingshang.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，宋李爽圍壽州，田俊邁入蘄縣，秦詵攻蔡州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renwu, Song's Li Shuang besieged Shouzhou; Tian Junmai entered Qi county; Qin Shen attacked Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu, Song's Li Shuang besieged Shouzhou, Tian Junmai entered Qi county, and Qin Shen attacked Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 防禦使完顏佛住敗之。

translations.literal: Defense Commissioner Wanyan Fozhu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Defense Commissioner Wanyan Fozhu beat them off.

sentences.zh: 又入金城海口，殺長山尉，執二巡檢以去。

translations.literal: They also entered the Jincheng sea mouth, killed the Changshan sheriff, seized two inspectors, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They also entered the Jincheng sea mouth, killed the Changshan sheriff, took two inspectors captive, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiashen Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以宋叛盟出師，告於天地太廟社稷。

translations.literal: On bingxu, because Song had violated the alliance, troops were dispatched and the matter was reported to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, because Song had broken the treaty, the court took the field and announced the campaign to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，親告于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor personally reported at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor made the announcement in person at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，平章政事僕散揆兼左副元帥，陝西兵馬都統使充為元帥右監軍，知真定府事烏古論誼為元帥左都監。

translations.literal: On wuzi Grand Councilor Pusan Kui was additionally made left deputy grand marshal; Shaanxi Cavalry-and-Infantry Commander Chong was made the marshal's right army supervisor; and Zhending prefectural intendant Wugulun Yi was made the marshal's left army supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Grand Councilor Pusan Kui was also appointed left deputy grand marshal; Shaanxi Cavalry-and-Infantry Commander Chong became the marshal's right army supervisor; and Zhending intendant Wugulun Yi became the marshal's left army supervisor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以征南詔中外。

translations.literal: On xinmao the southern campaign edict was proclaimed throughout court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the edict for the southern campaign was announced to the whole empire.

sentences.zh: 賜唐州刺史吾古孫兀屯、總押鄧州軍馬事完顏江山爵各二級，蔡州防禦使完顏佛住爵一級，餘賞賚有差。

translations.literal: Tangzhou Prefect Wugusun Wutun and overall commander of Dengzhou military affairs Wanyan Jiangshan were each advanced two ranks in nobility; Caizhou Defense Commissioner Wanyan Fozhu one rank; the rest received rewards in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Tangzhou Prefect Wugusun Wutun and overall commander of Dengzhou forces Wanyan Jiangshan were each raised two noble ranks; Caizhou Defense Commissioner Wanyan Fozhu one rank; and the rest were rewarded in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 又以非嚴整上變，必為所誤，授整嵩州巡檢使，賜爵八級，錢二百萬。

translations.literal: Moreover, had Yan Zheng not reported upward, the court would assuredly have been deceived; he was appointed Songzhou surveillance commissioner, granted eighth-rank enfeoffment, and given two million cash.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, but for Yan Zheng's intelligence report the court would surely have been misled; he was made Songzhou surveillance commissioner, enfeoffed at the eighth rank, and given two million cash.

sentences.zh: 上以宋兵方熾，東北新調之兵未集，河南之眾不足支，命河北、大名、北京、天山之兵萬五千屯真定、河間、清、獻等以為應。

translations.literal: Because Song troops were then at their height, newly transferred northeastern forces had not yet assembled, and Henan's numbers were insufficient to sustain the fight, troops of Hebei, Daming, Beijing, and Tianshan — fifteen thousand in all — were stationed at Zhending, Hejian, Qing, Xian, and the like as a reserve.
translations.idiomatic: With Song forces surging, northeastern reinforcements not yet gathered, and Henan too weak to hold the line, fifteen thousand men from Hebei, Daming, Beijing, and Tianshan were posted at Zhending, Hejian, Qing, Xian, and nearby places as a reserve.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，諭尚書省：「今國家多故，凡言軍國利害，五品以上官以次奏陳，朕將親問之。

translations.literal: On renchen he instructed the Masters of Writing: "The state now faces many emergencies; wherever military or state affairs touch the public good, officials of the fifth rank and above are to report in turn, and I shall question them personally.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he told the Masters of Writing: "The realm is in crisis; on any matter of military or state interest, fifth-rank officials and above shall present reports in order, and I will hear them myself.

sentences.zh: 六品以下則具帖子以進。

translations.literal: Those of the sixth rank and below are to submit written memos."
translations.idiomatic: Sixth-rank officials and below shall submit written memos."

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，山東路災，赦死罪已下。

translations.literal: On guisi disaster struck the Shandong circuit; those guilty of death and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Shandong suffered disaster and an amnesty was granted through crimes short of death.

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使完顏匡為右副元帥。

translations.literal: Privy Council Vice Commissioner Wanyan Kuang was made right deputy grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council Vice Commissioner Wanyan Kuang was appointed right deputy grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 宋田俊邁攻宿州，安國軍節度副使納蘭邦烈等出兵擊之。

translations.literal: Song's Tian Junmai attacked Suzhou; An'guo Army deputy jiedushi Nalan Banglei and others led troops out against him.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Junmai of Song attacked Suzhou; An'guo Army Deputy Jiedushi Nalan Banglei and others marched out to meet him.

sentences.zh: 邦烈中流矢，宋郭悼、李汝翼參眾繼至，遂圍宿州。

translations.literal: Banglei was struck by a stray arrow; Song's Guo Dao and Li Ruyi joined the mass of troops that followed and then besieged Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Banglei took a stray arrow; Guo Dao and Li Ruyi of Song brought up the main body and laid siege to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，納蘭邦烈等擊敗之，俊邁退保於蘄。

translations.literal: On renchen Nalan Banglei and the others defeated them, and Junmai withdrew to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Nalan Banglei and his men routed them, and Junmai fell back on Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，執俊邁於蘄。

translations.literal: On guimao Junmai was captured at Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Junmai was taken prisoner at Qi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，皇甫斌攻唐州，刺史吾古孫兀屯拒之。

translations.literal: On jiachen Huangfu Bin attacked Tangzhou; Prefect Wugusun Wutun held him off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Huangfu Bin attacked Tangzhou; Prefect Wugusun Wutun resisted.

sentences.zh: 行省遣泌陽副巡檢納合軍勝來援，遂擊敗之。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat sent Biyang deputy surveillance commissioner Nahe Junsheng to reinforce him, and they defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat dispatched Biyang Deputy Surveillance Commissioner Nahe Junsheng to the rescue, and the Jin forces beat them back.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On gengxu Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥朔，左丞僕散端以母憂罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the xinhai new moon, Left Vice Director Pusan Duan left office for his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinhai new moon, Left Vice Director Pusan Duan resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 平章政事揆報蘄之捷，並送所獲宋將田俊邁至闕。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Kui reported victory at Qi and sent the captured Song commander Tian Junmai to court.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Kui reported the victory at Qi and forwarded the captured Song commander Tian Junmai to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上降詔褒諭，賜紇石烈貞、納蘭邦烈、史扢搭等爵賞有差。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict of praise and reward; Heshilie Zhen, Nalan Banglei, Shi Geda, and others received enfeoffments and gifts in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent down a commendatory edict; Heshilie Zhen, Nalan Banglei, Shi Geda, and the rest were given noble ranks and rewards in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 宋將李爽以兵圍壽州，刺史徒單羲拒守，逾月不能下。

translations.literal: Song commander Li Shuang with troops besieged Shouzhou; Prefect Tushan Xi held the defense, and after more than a month the city still had not fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Song commander Li Shuang besieged Shouzhou with his army; Prefect Tushan Xi held out, and for more than a month the city would not yield.

sentences.zh: 壬子，河南統軍判官乞住及買哥等以兵來援，羲出兵應之，爽大敗，同知軍州事蒲烈古中流矢死。

translations.literal: On renzi Henan Army Command judge Wulinda Qizhu and Maige and others came with relief troops; Xi led his forces out in support; Shuang was routed, and army-and-prefecture vice administrator Puliegu died of a stray arrow.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Henan Army Command Judge Wulinda Qizhu and Maige and others arrived with reinforcements; Xi marched out to meet them; Shuang was crushed, and army-and-prefecture vice administrator Puliegu was killed by a stray arrow.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，初置急遞鋪，腰鈴轉遞，日行三百里，非軍期、河防不許起馬。

translations.literal: On yimao express relay stations were first established, relaying by waist bells at three hundred li a day; horses were not to be used except for military deadlines and river defense.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao express relay stations were set up for the first time, with waist-bell relays covering three hundred li a day; horses might be pressed into service only for military deadlines and river works.

sentences.zh: 定軍前差發受贓罪。

translations.literal: Penalties were fixed for bribe-taking in pre-campaign dispatch from the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Penalties were set for taking bribes in advance army assignments.

sentences.zh: 除飛蝗入境雖不損苗稼亦坐罪法。

translations.literal: The law was abolished whereby one was still punished when flying locusts entered the territory even though the crops were undamaged.
translations.idiomatic: The statute punishing officials when locusts entered the border even without crop damage was repealed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔彰德府，宋韓侂胄祖琦墳毋得損壞，仍禁樵采。

translations.literal: On dingsi an edict to Zhangde prefecture ordered that the tomb of Han Qi, ancestor of Song's Han Tuozhou, must not be harmed and that woodcutting there was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhangde prefecture was told that the tomb of Han Qi, Han Tuozhou's ancestor, must be left intact and that logging there was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庚申，右翼都統完顏賽不敗宋曹統制于溱水。

translations.literal: On gengshen Right Wing Unified Commander Wanyan Saibu defeated Song Military Commissioner Cao at the Zhen River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Right Wing Unified Commander Wanyan Saibu routed Song Military Commissioner Cao on the Zhen River.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔有司，有宋宗族所居，各具以聞。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict ordered the relevant offices to report every place where Song imperial clansmen resided.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court ordered the relevant offices to list every locality where Song imperial clansmen lived.

sentences.zh: 長官常加提控。

translations.literal: Senior officials were to keep them under strict oversight.
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials were to supervise them closely.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，平章政事揆報壽州之捷。

translations.literal: On renxu Grand Councilor Kui reported victory at Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Grand Councilor Kui reported the victory at Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔升壽州為防禦，免今年租稅諸科名錢，釋死罪以下。

translations.literal: On wuchen an edict promoted Shouzhou to a defense command, exempted this year's rents, taxes, and nominal levies, and released those guilty of death and below.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Shouzhou was raised to a defense command, this year's rents, taxes, and assorted levies were remitted, and prisoners down to capital offenses were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 以徒單羲為防禦使。

translations.literal: Tushan Xi was made defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tushan Xi was appointed defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 贈蒲烈古昭勇大將軍，賜錢三百貫，官其子圖剌。

translations.literal: Puliegu was posthumously enfeoffed General of Brave Valor, granted three hundred strings of cash, and his son Tula was given office.
translations.idiomatic: Puliegu was posthumously made General of Brave Valor, given three hundred strings of cash, and his son Tula was granted an official post.

sentences.zh: 擢乞住同知昌武軍節度使事，買哥河南路統軍判官。

translations.literal: Wulinda Qizhu was promoted to associate administrator of Changwu Army-and-Prefecture affairs; Maige was made Henan Route Army Command judge.
translations.idiomatic: Wulinda Qizhu was promoted to associate administrator of Changwu Army-and-Prefecture affairs, and Maige was made judge of the Henan Route Army Command.

sentences.zh: 都統賽不、副統蒲鮮萬奴各進爵一級，賜金幣有差。

translations.literal: Commander-in-chief Saibu and deputy commander Puxian Wannu each advanced one rank in nobility; gold and coins were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Saibu and deputy commander Puxian Wannu were each raised one noble rank and given gold and coin rewards in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛未，木星晝見，至七月戊申，經天。

translations.literal: On xinwei Jupiter was seen in daylight; until seventh month wushen it crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Jupiter appeared by day and remained visible until it crossed the sky on wushen in the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宋吳曦攻鹽川，戍將完顏王喜敗之。

translations.literal: On yihai Song's Wu Xi attacked Yanchuan; garrison commander Wanyan Wangxi defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wu Xi of Song attacked Yanchuan; garrison commander Wanyan Wangxi beat him off.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，宋商榮複攻東海，縣令完顏卞僧複敗之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guiwei Song's Shang Rong again attacked Donghai; magistrate Wanyan Biansengfu again defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on guiwei of the seventh month, Song's Shang Rong again attacked Donghai; magistrate Wanyan Biansengfu again routed him.

sentences.zh: 還，中伏矢死，贈海州刺史，以銀五百兩，絹百匹給其家，仍官其一子。

translations.literal: On the return he was struck by an ambush arrow and died; posthumously made Haizhou prefect; five hundred taels of silver and one hundred bolts of silk were given his family, and one son was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On the way back he was killed by an ambush arrow; he was posthumously made prefect of Haizhou, his family given five hundred taels of silver and one hundred bolts of silk, and one son granted an official post.

sentences.zh: 甲申，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On jiashen court sacrifice was offered at Yansqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the court presented sacrifice at Yansqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕翰林直學士陳大任妨本職專修《遼史》。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict ordered Hanlin direct academician Chen Daren to set aside his regular post and compile the History of Liao exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor ordered Hanlin direct academician Chen Daren excused from his regular duties to compile the History of Liao full time.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宋統制戚春以舟師攻邳州，刺史完顏從正敗之，春赴水死，斬其副夏統制。

translations.literal: On jiawu Song commander Qi Chun attacked Pizhou with a naval force; prefect Wanyan Congzheng defeated him; Chun drowned himself; his deputy Commander Xia was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Song commander Qi Chun attacked Pizhou with a fleet; prefect Wanyan Congzheng defeated him; Chun threw himself into the water and died, and his deputy Commander Xia was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 吳曦兵五萬入秦州，陝西路都統副使承裕等敗之。

translations.literal: Wu Xi's army of fifty thousand entered Qinzhou; Shaanxi Circuit deputy regional commander-in-chief Chengyu and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xi led fifty thousand men into Qinzhou; Chengyu, deputy regional commander of Shaanxi Circuit, and others routed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，夏國王李純佑廢，侄安全立，遣使奉表來告。

translations.literal: On bingshen Xia king Li Chunyou was deposed; his nephew Anquan was enthroned; envoys were sent with a memorial to report it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen King Li Chunyou of Xia was deposed and his nephew Anquan enthroned; envoys came with a memorial announcing it.

sentences.zh: 詔禁賣馬入外境，但至界欲賣而為所捕即論死。

translations.literal: An edict forbade selling horses beyond the border; anyone who reached the frontier intending to sell and was caught was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: An edict banned selling horses outside the realm; anyone caught at the border about to sell was put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，山東帥來報邳州之捷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengxu the Shandong commander reported the victory at Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, the Shandong commander reported the victory at Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，木星晨見。

translations.literal: On xinhai Jupiter was seen at dawn.
