translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Jupiter appeared at dawn.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以羌酋青宜可為壘州副都總管。

translations.literal: On yimao Qiang chieftain Qingyike was made deputy overall commander of Lei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Qiang chieftain Qingyike was appointed deputy overall commander of Lei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiwei Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Venus was seen by day.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，左丞僕散端起複前職。

translations.literal: On bingyin Left Censor Pusan Duan resumed his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Left Censor Pusan Duan returned to his former office.

sentences.zh: 詔設平南諸將軍。

translations.literal: An edict established the generals for pacifying the south.
translations.idiomatic: An edict created the posts of generals for pacifying the south.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋程松襲取方山原，蒲察貞破走之。

translations.literal: On xinwei Song's Cheng Song seized Fangshanyuan; Pucha Zhen drove him off in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Song's Cheng Song took Fangshanyuan; Pucha Zhen routed him.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On renshen Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Venus was seen by day and crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，赦唐、鄧、潁、蔡、宿、泗六州，免來年租稅三分之一。

translations.literal: On yihai Tang, Deng, Ying, Cai, Su, and Si — six prefectures — were granted amnesty; one-third of next year's land tax and corvée levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an amnesty was proclaimed for Tang, Deng, Ying, Cai, Su, and Si, and one-third of the next year's land tax and corvée levies was remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯朔，天壽節，高麗遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jimao new moon, Heavenly Longevity Festival; Goryeo sent envoys with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the ninth month, the Heavenly Longevity Festival, Goryeo sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，元帥右都監蒲察貞取和尚原，臨洮蕃部遵寧獻芻粟、戰馬以助軍。

translations.literal: On xinsi Marshal and right overseer Pucha Zhen took Heshangyuan; Lintao tribal leader Zunning presented fodder, grain, and war horses to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Marshal Pucha Zhen, right overseer, captured Heshangyuan; the Lintao tribesman Zunning sent fodder, grain, and war horses to support the army.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，將五鼓，北方有赤白氣數道，起于王良之下，行至北斗開陽、搖光之東。

translations.literal: On yiyou, about the fifth watch, several streaks of red and white qi in the north rose below Wangliang and ran east of Kaiyang and Yaoguang in the Big Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, near the fifth watch, several bands of red and white vapor in the north rose below Wangliang and stretched east of Kaiyang and Yaoguang in the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，幸香山。

translations.literal: On bingxu he visited Xiangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he went to Xiangshan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕行尚書省，有方略出眾、武藝絕倫、才幹辦事、工巧過人者，其招選之。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Mobile Secretariat was ordered to recruit those outstanding in strategy, unmatched in martial arts, capable in administration, or surpassing in craftsmanship.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Mobile Secretariat was told to recruit men outstanding in strategy, unequaled in arms, able in affairs, or exceptional in craft.

sentences.zh: 甲午，參知政事賈鉉乞致政，不許。

translations.literal: On jiawu Vice Administrator Jia Xuan asked to retire; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Vice Administrator Jia Xuan asked to retire; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，尚書左丞僕散端行省於汴。

translations.literal: On wuxu Minister of the Left Pusan Duan established a branch secretariat at Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Minister of the Left Pusan Duan set up a branch secretariat at Bian.

sentences.zh: 己亥，尚書戶部侍郎梁鏜行六部尚書事于山東。

translations.literal: On jihai Vice Minister of Revenue Liang Tang acted as minister of the Six Departments in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Vice Minister of Revenue Liang Tang handled the affairs of the Six Departments in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣尚書左司郎中溫蒂罕思敬冊李安全為夏國王。

translations.literal: On xinchou Minister Left Division Director Wendantihan Sijing was sent to invest Li Anquan as king of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Minister Left Division Director Wendantihan Sijing was dispatched to invest Li Anquan as king of Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宋吳曦將馮興、楊雄、李圭等入秦州，陝西都統副使承裕等擊破之，斬楊雄、李珪。

translations.literal: On jiachen Song generals under Wu Xi — Feng Xing, Yang Xiong, Li Gui, and others — entered Qinzhou; Shaanxi deputy regional commander Chengyu and others routed them and beheaded Yang Xiong and Li Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wu Xi's generals Feng Xing, Yang Xiong, Li Gui, and others entered Qinzhou; Chengyu, deputy regional commander of Shaanxi, and others defeated them and beheaded Yang Xiong and Li Gui.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申朔，平章政事僕散揆督諸道兵伐宋。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wushen new moon; Senior Administrator Pusan Kui supervised armies from all circuits in the campaign against Song.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the wushen new moon of the tenth month, Senior Administrator Pusan Kui took command of troops from every circuit for the campaign against Song.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，揆以行省兵三萬出潁、壽，河南路統軍使紇石烈子仁以兵三萬出渦口，元帥匡以兵二萬五千出唐、鄧，左監軍紇石烈執中以山東兵二萬出清口，右監軍充以關中兵一萬出陳倉，右都監蒲察貞以岐、隴兵一萬出成紀，蜀漢路安撫使完顏綱以漢、蕃步騎一萬出臨潭，臨洮路兵馬都總管石抹仲溫以隴右步騎五千出鹽川，隴州防禦使完顏璘以本部兵五千出來遠。

translations.literal: On gengxu Kui with thirty thousand branch-secretariat troops issued from Ying and Shou; Henan Route army commander Heshilie Ziren with thirty thousand from Wokou; Marshal Kuang with twenty-five thousand from Tang and Deng; left overseer Heshilie Zhizhong with twenty thousand Shandong troops from Qingkou; right overseer Chong with ten thousand Guanzhong troops from Chencang; right overseer Pucha Zhen with ten thousand Qi-Long troops from Chengji; Sichuan-Han Route pacification commissioner Wanyan Gang with ten thousand Han and tribal foot and horse from Lintan; Lintao Route commander-in-chief Shimozhong Wen with five thousand Longyou foot and horse from Yanchuan; Longzhou defense commissioner Wanyan Lin with five thousand local troops from Laiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Kui marched thirty thousand branch-secretariat troops out of Ying and Shou; Henan Route army commander Heshilie Ziren thirty thousand from Wokou; Marshal Kuang twenty-five thousand from Tang and Deng; left overseer Heshilie Zhizhong twenty thousand Shandong men from Qingkou; right overseer Chong ten thousand Guanzhong men from Chencang; right overseer Pucha Zhen ten thousand Qi-Long men from Chengji; Sichuan-Han Route pacification commissioner Wanyan Gang ten thousand Han and tribal infantry and cavalry from Lintan; Lintao Route commander-in-chief Shimozhong Wen five thousand Longyou infantry and cavalry from Yanchuan; and Longzhou defense commissioner Wanyan Lin five thousand local troops from Laiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiazi he hunted in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅朔，詔定諸州府物力差役式。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuyin new moon; an edict fixed formulas for levies of goods and corvée by prefecture and district.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the eleventh month an edict set the formulas for property levies and corvée labor in every prefecture and district.

sentences.zh: 壬午，完顏匡攻下棘陽。

translations.literal: On renwu Wanyan Kuang captured Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wanyan Kuang took Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔屯田軍戶與所居民為婚姻者聽。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict permitted military colonists to marry local residents.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict allowed garrison colonists to marry people of the districts where they were posted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，僕散揆克安豐軍，取霍丘縣。

translations.literal: On dinghai Pusan Kui took Anfeng Army and captured Huoqiu County.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Pusan Kui captured Anfeng Army and took Huoqiu County.

sentences.zh: 紇石烈執中克淮陰，遂圍楚州。

translations.literal: Heshilie Zhizhong took Huaiyin and then besieged Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Heshilie Zhizhong seized Huaiyin and then laid siege to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，尚書省奏，減朝官及承應人月俸折支錢。

translations.literal: On jichou the Secretariat memorialized to reduce the paper-money portion of monthly salaries for court officials and attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Secretariat reported a cut in the paper-money supplement to the monthly pay of court officials and attendants.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，完顏匡克光化軍及神馬坡。

translations.literal: On gengyin Wanyan Kuang took Guanghua Army and Shenmapo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Wanyan Kuang captured Guanghua Army and Shenmapo.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，僕散揆次盧江。

translations.literal: On renchen Pusan Kui encamped at Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Pusan Kui halted at Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 宋督視江淮兵馬事丘灊遣劉祐來乞和。

translations.literal: Song overseer of Huai-Jiang forces Qiu Jin sent Liu You to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Jin, Song's overseer of Huai-Jiang forces, sent Liu You to beg for peace.

sentences.zh: 紇石烈子仁克定遠縣。

translations.literal: Heshilie Ziren captured Dingyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Heshilie Ziren took Dingyuan County.

sentences.zh: 乙未，完顏匡取隨州。

translations.literal: On yiwei Wanyan Kuang took Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wanyan Kuang captured Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，紇石烈子仁克滁州。

translations.literal: On bingshen Heshilie Ziren took Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Heshilie Ziren captured Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔諸路行用小鈔。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict ordered all circuits to use small-denomination notes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict required every circuit to circulate small banknotes.

sentences.zh: 完顏匡圍德安，別以兵徇下安陸、應城、雲夢、孝感、漢川、荊山等縣。

translations.literal: Wanyan Kuang besieged De'an; separately he sent troops to subdue Anlu, Yingcheng, Yunmeng, Xiaogan, Hanchuan, Jingshan, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Kuang besieged De'an and detached troops to overrun Anlu, Yingcheng, Yunmeng, Xiaogan, Hanchuan, Jingshan, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 庚子，日斜，有流星二，光芒如炬，幾及一丈，起東北沒東南。

translations.literal: On gengzi, as the sun declined, two meteors with torch-like glare nearly a zhang long rose in the northeast and set in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, in late afternoon, two meteors flared like torches nearly a zhang long, rising in the northeast and vanishing in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 初定茶禁。

translations.literal: Tea monopoly regulations were first established.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for the tea monopoly were first promulgated.

sentences.zh: 完顏綱圍祐州，降之。

translations.literal: Wanyan Gang besieged Youzhou and it surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Gang besieged Youzhou and the city surrendered.

sentences.zh: 宋丘灊遣林拱持書乞和。

translations.literal: Song’s Qiu Tan sent Lin Gong with a letter suing for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Song’s Qiu Tan sent Lin Gong with a letter begging for peace.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，完顏匡攻襄陽，破其外城。

translations.literal: On xinchou Wanyan Kuang attacked Xiangyang and broke the outer wall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wanyan Kuang attacked Xiangyang and breached the outer wall.

sentences.zh: 僕散揆克含山，蒲察貞克天水，紇石烈子仁徇下來安、全椒二縣。

translations.literal: Pushan Kuo took Heshan, Pucha Zhen took Tianshui, and He Shilie Ziren swept down and took Lai’an and Quanjiao counties.
translations.idiomatic: Pushan Kuo captured Heshan, Pucha Zhen captured Tianshui, and He Shilie Ziren marched through and reduced Lai’an and Quanjiao counties.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，完顏綱徇下荔川、閭川等城。

translations.literal: On renyin Wanyan Gang swept down and took Licchuan, Lüchuan, and other cities.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wanyan Gang marched through and reduced Licchuan, Lüchuan, and other towns.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，丘灊複遣宋顯等以書幣乞和。

translations.literal: On guimao Qiu Tan again sent Song Xian and others with letters and gifts to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Qiu Tan again sent Song Xian and others with letters and gifts to beg for peace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，完顏綱克宕昌。

translations.literal: On yisi Wanyan Gang took Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wanyan Gang captured Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，蒲察貞克西和州。

translations.literal: On bingwu Pucha Zhen took Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Pucha Zhen captured Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未朔，完顏匡克宜城，僕散揆攻和州，史乂搭中流矢死。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the dingwei new moon, Wanyan Kuang took Yicheng; Pushan Kuo attacked Hezhou; Shi Yida was struck by an arrow midstream and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingwei new moon, Wanyan Kuang took Yicheng; Pushan Kuo attacked Hezhou; Shi Yida was hit by an arrow in mid-river and died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，完顏綱次大潭縣，降之。

translations.literal: On renzi Wanyan Gang halted at Datang County and it surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wanyan Gang encamped at Datang County and the county submitted.

sentences.zh: 蒲察貞克成州。

translations.literal: Pucha Zhen took Chengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Zhen captured Chengzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，宋太尉、昭信軍節度使、四川宣撫副使吳曦納款于完顏綱。

translations.literal: On guichou Song Grand Marshal, Zhaoxin Army military commissioner, and Sichuan pacification vice commissioner Wu Xi submitted allegiance to Wanyan Gang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Song Grand Marshal, military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army, and Sichuan pacification vice commissioner Wu Xi defected to Wanyan Gang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，右監軍充攻下大散關。

translations.literal: On wuwu Right Army Supervisor Chong took Great Scatter Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Right Army Supervisor Chong captured Great Scatter Pass.

sentences.zh: 己未，紇石烈子仁克真州，丘灊複遣陳璧等奉書乞和。

translations.literal: On jiwei He Shilie Ziren took Zhenzhou; Qiu Tan again sent Chen Bi and others with letters suing for peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei He Shilie Ziren took Zhenzhou; Qiu Tan again sent Chen Bi and others with letters begging for peace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，右監軍充遣兀顏抄合以兵趣鳳州，城潰入焉。

translations.literal: On xinyou Right Army Supervisor Chong sent Wanyan Chaohe with troops toward Fengzhou; the walls collapsed and they entered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Right Army Supervisor Chong sent Wanyan Chaohe with troops toward Fengzhou; the walls gave way and the army entered.

sentences.zh: 完顏綱遣京兆錄事張仔會吳曦於興州之置口。

translations.literal: Wanyan Gang sent Jingzhao registrar Zhang Zai to meet Wu Xi at Zhikou in Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Gang sent Jingzhao registrar Zhang Zai to meet Wu Xi at Zhikou in Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 曦具言所以歸朝之意，仔請以告身為報，盡出以付之，仍獻階州。

translations.literal: Xi fully explained his reasons for submitting to the court; Zai asked for his commission documents as proof, and Xi produced them all; he also offered Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xi set out in full his reasons for coming over to the court; Zai asked for his appointment papers as proof, and Xi handed them all over; he also offered Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，初設都提控急遞鋪官。

translations.literal: On yichou the post of director-general controlling express relay stations was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the office of director-general over express relay stations was first established.

sentences.zh: 平章政事僕散揆班師。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Pushan Kuo withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Pushan Kuo withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 完顏綱以朝命，假太倉使馬良顯齎詔書、金印立吳曦為蜀王。

translations.literal: By court order Wanyan Gang had Taicang envoy Ma Liangxian carry the patent and gold seal to enfeoff Wu Xi as King of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On court order Wanyan Gang had Taicang envoy Ma Liangxian bear the patent and gold seal to enfeoff Wu Xi as King of Shu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，蒲察貞以西和、天水等捷來報。

translations.literal: On wuchen Pucha Zhen reported victories at Xihe, Tianshui, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Pucha Zhen reported victories at Xihe, Tianshui, and the like.

sentences.zh: 完顏匡進所掠女子百人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Kuang presented one hundred captive women.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Kuang presented one hundred captive women.

sentences.zh: 己巳，曦遣其果州團練使郭澄、提舉仙人關使任辛奉表及蜀地圖志、吳氏譜牒來上。

translations.literal: On jisi Xi sent his Guozhou regiment trainer Guo Cheng and overseer of Xianren Pass Ren Xin to present a memorial, maps of Shu, and Wu family genealogies.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Xi sent his Guozhou regiment trainer Guo Cheng and overseer of Xianren Pass Ren Xin to present a memorial, maps of Shu, and Wu clan genealogies.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔完顏匡權尚書右丞，行省事、右副元帥如故。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict made Wanyan Kuang acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, continuing as commissioner and Right Deputy Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an edict appointed Wanyan Kuang acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, while he continued as commissioner and Right Deputy Marshal.

sentences.zh: 以紇石烈執中縱下虜掠，遣近臣杖其經歷阿裏不孫等，仍詔放還所掠。

translations.literal: Because He Shilie Zhizhong had let subordinates plunder captives, close attendants were sent to cane his clerk Alibusun and others; an edict also ordered all seized persons released.
translations.idiomatic: Because He Shilie Zhizhong had allowed his men to plunder captives, the emperor sent close attendants to cane his clerk Alibusun and others, and also ordered everything taken to be returned.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丁丑朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, on the dingchou new moon, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In year seven, on the dingchou new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys came from Goryeo and Xia.

sentences.zh: 完顏匡進攻襄陽。

translations.literal: Wanyan Kuang again attacked Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Kuang again attacked Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，敕宰臣舉材幹官同議南征事。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict ordered the chief councillors to nominate capable officials to discuss the southern campaign together.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict told the chief councillors to recommend capable officials to deliberate the southern campaign together.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔御史大夫崇肅、同判大睦親府事徒單懷忠、吏部尚書范楫、戶部尚書高汝礪、禮部尚書張行簡、知大興府事溫蒂罕思齊等十有四人同對於慶和殿。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict ordered Censor-in-chief Chong Su, Associate Director of the Great Muziqin Mansion Tushan Huaizhong, Minister of Personnel Fan Ji, Minister of Revenue Gao Ruli, Minister of Rites Zhang Xingjian, Administrator of Daxing Wendihan Siqi, and fourteen others in all to answer together at Qinghe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict summoned Censor-in-chief Chong Su, Associate Director of the Great Muziqin Mansion Tushan Huaizhong, Minister of Personnel Fan Ji, Minister of Revenue Gao Ruli, Minister of Rites Zhang Xingjian, Administrator of Daxing Wendihan Siqi, and fourteen others in all to confer together at Qinghe Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔百官及前十四人同對於廣仁殿。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered all officials and the foregoing fourteen to answer together at Guangren Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict ordered all officials and the same fourteen to confer together at Guangren Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲申，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On jiashen he made court offering at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he offered court sacrifice at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，贈故壽州死節軍士魏全宣武將軍、蒙城令，封其妻鄉君，子俟年至十五收充八貫石正班局分承應，仍賜錢百萬。

translations.literal: On yiyou the martyr soldier Wei Quan of Shouzhou was posthumously made Xuanwu General and magistrate of Mengcheng; his wife was enfeoffed District Lady; his son Hou, when he reached fifteen, was to be enrolled as a regular-bureau attendant in the eight-guanshi office; one million cash was also granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Wei Quan, a Shouzhou soldier who died holding his post, was posthumously made Xuanwu General and magistrate of Mengcheng; his wife was enfeoffed as District Lady; his son Hou, at age fifteen, was to enter the eight-guanshi regular-bureau attendant roster; and one million cash was granted besides.

sentences.zh: 初，李爽圍壽州，刺史羲募人往斫敵營，全在選中，而為敵所執。

translations.literal: Earlier Li Shuang besieged Shouzhou; Prefect Yi recruited men to strike the enemy camp; Quan was selected but was captured by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Shuang had besieged Shouzhou; Prefect Yi recruited men to raid the enemy camp; Quan was chosen but was taken by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 敵令罵羲則免，全陽許，及至城下，反罵敵，遂殺之。

translations.literal: The enemy said that if he cursed Yi he would be spared; Quan falsely agreed, but reaching below the wall he cursed the enemy instead and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy promised to spare him if he cursed Yi; Quan pretended to agree, but at the foot of the wall he cursed the enemy instead and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 至死罵不絕聲，故是有恩。

translations.literal: He cursed without ceasing until death; hence the favor.
translations.idiomatic: He kept cursing to the end; hence the court’s favor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，召完顏綱赴闕。

translations.literal: On wuzi Wanyan Gang was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Wanyan Gang was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，僕散揆還駐下蔡而病。

translations.literal: On gengyin Pushan Kuo returned to station at Xia’ai but fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Pushan Kuo went back to camp at Xia’ai and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以左丞相宗浩兼都元帥，行省于南京以代揆。

translations.literal: On bingchen Left Chief Councillor Zong Hao was also made supreme commander and commissioner at Nanjing to replace Kuo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Left Chief Councillor Zong Hao was also made supreme commander and posted as commissioner at Nanjing in Kuo’s place.

sentences.zh: 己亥，有司奏更定茶禁。

translations.literal: On jihai the relevant offices memorialized revising the tea prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the relevant offices reported on revising the tea monopoly.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，完顏匡取穀城。

translations.literal: On xinchou Wanyan Kuang took Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wanyan Kuang captured Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，幸太極宮。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuzi, he visited the Taiji Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, he visited the Taiji Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔撫陝西軍士。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict ordered comfort for Shaanxi soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict ordered the Shaanxi troops to be comforted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，初定蟲蝻生髮地主及鄰主首不申之罪。

translations.literal: On renchen penalties were first fixed for landowners where locust broods hatch and for neighboring landlords who fail to report.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen penalties were first set for landowners on whose land locust broods appear and for neighboring landlords who fail to report them.

sentences.zh: 宋複攻破階州。

translations.literal: Song again retook Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces again retook Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，複攻破西州。

translations.literal: On guisi they again retook Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi they again retook Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宣撫副使完顏綱至鳳翔，詔撤五州之兵，分保要害，綱召諸軍還。

translations.literal: On yiwei Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Gang reached Fengxiang; an edict withdrew troops of the five prefectures to hold key points; Gang summoned the armies back.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Gang reached Fengxiang; an edict pulled back the troops of five prefectures to guard vital points, and Gang recalled the armies.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以完顏匡為左副元帥。

translations.literal: On gengzi Wanyan Kuang was made Left Deputy Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wanyan Kuang was appointed Left Deputy Marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On renyin he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸西園。

translations.literal: On jiachen he visited the Western Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he visited the Western Garden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，遣宮籍副監楊序為橫賜高麗王使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renzi, Deputy Palace Registrar Yang Xu was sent as horizontal-grant envoy to the king of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renzi, Deputy Palace Registrar Yang Xu was sent as horizontal-grant envoy to the king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，宋人攻破散關，鞏州鈐轄兀顏阿失死之。

translations.literal: On guichou Song forces took San Pass; Gongzhou surveillance commissioner Wanyan Ashi died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Song troops captured San Pass, and Gongzhou Surveillance Commissioner Wanyan Ashi was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以紇石烈子仁為右副元帥。

translations.literal: On bingchen Heshilie Ziren was made right deputy marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Heshilie Ziren was appointed right deputy marshal.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔元帥府分遣諸將游奕淮南諸州。

translations.literal: On wuchen an edict ordered the marshalate to dispatch its generals on mobile patrols through the Huainan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court ordered the marshalate to send its generals on roving patrols through the Huainan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸西，複下散關。

translations.literal: On guiyou San Pass was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou San Pass was retaken.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，幸東園射柳。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jimao, he visited East Park for willow-shooting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, he went to East Park for willow-shooting.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸玉泉山。

translations.literal: On jichou he visited Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he went to Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，宋知樞密院事張嚴複遣方信孺以書至都元帥府，增歲弊乞和。

translations.literal: On bingshen Song Grand Councilor of Military Affairs Zhang Yan again sent Fang Xinru with a letter to the Grand Marshalate, increasing the annual tribute and begging peace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Song’s Zhang Yan, grand councilor of military affairs, again sent Fang Xinru with a letter to the grand marshalate offering higher annual payments and suing for peace.

sentences.zh: 四川安撫使安丙遣西和州安撫使李孝羲率步騎三萬攻秦州，圍皁角堡。

translations.literal: Sichuan Pacification Commissioner An Bing sent Xihe Pacification Commissioner Li Xiaoyi with thirty thousand foot and horse to attack Qinzhou and besiege Zaojiao Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Pacification Commissioner An Bing sent Xihe Pacification Commissioner Li Xiaoyi with thirty thousand infantry and cavalry against Qinzhou and to besiege Zaojiao Fort.

sentences.zh: 朮虎高琪以兵赴之，七戰而解其圍。

translations.literal: Shuhu Gaoqi went to the rescue; after seven battles he broke the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhu Gaoqi marched to relieve the fort and, after seven engagements, lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 是月，放宮女二十人。

translations.literal: That month, twenty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: That month twenty palace women were released from service.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳朔，詔朝官六品、外官五品以上，及親王舉通錢谷官一人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yisi new moon, an edict ordered court officials of sixth rank and above and local officials of fifth rank and above, together with imperial princes, each to nominate one person versed in money and grain administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yisi new moon, the court ordered officials of sixth rank and above at court and fifth rank and above in the provinces, as well as imperial princes, each to nominate one expert in fiscal administration.

sentences.zh: 不舉者罰，舉不當者論如律。

translations.literal: Those who failed to nominate were punished; those whose nominees proved unfit were judged by statute.
translations.idiomatic: Failure to nominate was penalized, and unworthy nominees were punished under the law.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以山東盜，制同黨能自殺捕出首官賞法。

translations.literal: On jiyou, because of bandits in Shandong, regulations were issued on rewards for accomplices who killed, captured, or turned themselves in.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, with banditry in Shandong, the court set rewards for gang members who killed or seized fellows or came forward of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 戊午，烏古論誼為元帥左監軍，完顏撒剌為元帥左都監。

translations.literal: On wuwu Wugulun Yi was made left inspector of the marshalate, and Wanyan Sala was made left chief inspector of the marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Wugulun Yi became left inspector of the marshalate and Wanyan Sala left chief inspector of the marshalate.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣使捕蝗。

translations.literal: On yichou envoys were sent to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou envoys were dispatched to hunt locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengchen court offering was made at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengchen he offered court sacrifice at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔民間交易、典質，一貫以上並用交鈔，毋用錢。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ruled that in private trade and pawn transactions of one string or more, treasury notes alone were to be used and not coin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the court ordered that private sales and pawns of one string or more must be paid in treasury notes rather than cash.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，敕尚書省：「自今初受監察者令進利害帖子，以待召見。

translations.literal: On yiyou he charged the Masters of Writing: “From now on, those first appointed as surveillance censors are to submit memorials on harms and benefits, to await audience.”
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he instructed the Masters of Writing: “Hereafter, newly appointed surveillance censors must file memorials on public harms and benefits pending summons to audience.”

sentences.zh: 」甲午，左副元帥匡至自許州。

translations.literal: ” On jiawu Left Deputy Marshal Kuang arrived from Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: ” On jiawu Left Deputy Marshal Kuang returned from Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔核西夏人口，盡贖放還，敢有藏匿者以違制論。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict ordered a census of Western Xia captives; all were to be ransomed and sent home, and anyone who hid them was to be judged for violating an edict.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the court ordered a review of Western Xia captives, all to be ransomed and released; concealment was to be punished as defiance of an edict.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，宋張嚴複遣方信孺齊其主誓書槁來乞和。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wushen, Song’s Zhang Yan again sent Fang Xinru with his ruler’s draft oath to beg peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, Song’s Zhang Yan again sent Fang Xinru bearing his emperor’s draft oath text to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，割汝州襄城縣于許州。

translations.literal: On gengxu Xiangcheng county of Ruzhou was detached to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Xiangcheng county in Ruzhou was transferred to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On wuchen he returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌朔，天壽節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Goryeo and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiaxu new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: congratulatory envoys came from Goryeo and Xia.

sentences.zh: 左丞相兼都元帥宗浩薨於軍。

translations.literal: Left Chancellor and concurrent Grand Marshal Zong Hao died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chancellor and Grand Marshal Zong Hao died at the front.

sentences.zh: 甲申，定西、北京，遼東鹽司判官諸場管勾增虧升降格。

translations.literal: On jiashen grades for promotion and demotion were fixed for salt-field intendants, sub-intendants, and yard superintendents in Dingxi, Beijing, and Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen promotion and demotion standards were set for salt commissioners, vice-commissioners, and field superintendents in Dingxi, Beijing, and Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞僕散端為平章政事，封申國公，左副元帥完顏匡為平章政事兼左副元帥，封定國公。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Pusan Duan was made grand councilor and enfeoffed Duke of Shen; Left Deputy Marshal Wanyan Kuang was made grand councilor concurrent left deputy marshal and enfeoffed Duke of Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Pusan Duan became grand councilor and was enfeoffed Duke of Shen; Left Deputy Marshal Wanyan Kuang became grand councilor while retaining his marshal’s post and was enfeoffed Duke of Ding.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingxu he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，還宮。

translations.literal: On renchen he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，更定受制忘誤及誤寫制書事重加等罪。

translations.literal: On wuxu penalties were revised, with heavier added degrees, for receiving an edict in error and for miscopying imperial documents.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the court increased the graded penalties for mishandling edicts and for errors in copying imperial documents.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，敕女直人不得改為漢姓及學南人裝束。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict forbade Jurchen people to adopt Han surnames or to dress in southern styles.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court forbade Jurchens to take Han surnames or to adopt southern dress.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，詔應廕之家，旁正廕足，其正廕者未出官而亡，許補廕一人。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiachen an edict ruled that in families entitled to yin privilege, when collateral yin shares were full and the principal yin heir had died before taking office, one supplemental yin appointment was allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiachen the court ruled that where a yin-privilege family’s collateral shares were exhausted and the principal heir had died before office, one supplemental yin nomination might be made.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以武庫令朮甲法心為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Armory Director Shujia Faxin was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Armory Director Shujia Faxin was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingchen he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔定隨軍遷賞格。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict fixed grades for battlefield promotions with the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the court set standards for promotions earned on campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛未，陝西宣撫使徒單鎰分遣副統把回海攻下蘇嶺關。

translations.literal: On xinwei Shaanxi Pacification Commissioner Tushan Yi dispatched Deputy Commander Ba Huihai, who took Suling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Shaanxi Pacification Commissioner Tushan Yi sent Deputy Commander Ba Huihai, who captured Suling Pass.

sentences.zh: 是月，定南征將士功賞格。

translations.literal: That month, merit-reward scales for the southern campaign forces were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That month standards were set for rewarding merit in the southern expedition.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，詔新定學令內削去薛居正《五代史》，止用歐陽修所撰。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guiyou an edict ordered that within the newly fixed school statutes Xue Juzheng’s History of the Five Dynasties be removed and only Ouyang Xiu’s compilation used.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiyou the court ordered the new school regulations to drop Xue Juzheng’s History of the Five Dynasties and use only Ouyang Xiu’s version.

sentences.zh: 是日，都統押剌拔鶻 嶺關、新道口，副統回海取小湖關、敖倉，進至營口鎮，遂取其城。

translations.literal: That day Commander Yala Bahai took Huling Pass and Xindao Pass; Deputy Commander Huihai took Xiaohu Pass and Aocang, advanced to Yingkou town, and then took the city.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Commander Yala Bahai seized Huling Pass and Xindao Pass; Deputy Commander Huihai took Xiaohu Pass and Aocang, pushed on to Yingkou town, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 丙子，宋韓侂胄遣左司郎中王柟以書來乞和，請稱伯，複增歲幣、犒軍錢，誅蘇師旦函首以獻。

translations.literal: On bingzi Song’s Han Tuozhou sent Left Bureau Director Wang Nan with a letter begging peace, asking to style himself “elder uncle,” again to increase the annual tribute and army bounty, and to execute Su Shidan and present his head in a box.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Song’s Han Tuozhou sent Left Bureau Director Wang Nan suing for peace, offering to call himself the Jin emperor’s “elder uncle,” to raise the annual payments and army bounty again, and to execute Su Shidan and send his head in a box.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上聞陝州防禦使紇石烈孛孫禁民糶，命尚書省罪之。

translations.literal: On bingxu the emperor heard that Shaanzhou Defense Commissioner Heshilie Beisun had forbidden the people to sell grain and ordered the Masters of Writing to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, learning that Shaanzhou Defense Commissioner Heshilie Beisun had banned the people from selling grain, the emperor ordered the Masters of Writing to punish him.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宋參知政事錢象祖以誅韓侂胄移書行省。

translations.literal: On renchen Song Participation Councillor Qian Xiangzu wrote to the route headquarters reporting the execution of Han Tuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Song Participation Councillor Qian Xiangzu notified the route headquarters that Han Tuozhou had been executed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiawu he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，參知政事賈鉉罷。

translations.literal: On wuxu Participation Councillor Jia Xuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Participation Councillor Jia Xuan left office.

sentences.zh: 詔完顏匡檄宋，函侂胄首以贖淮南故地。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wanyan Kuang to send a proclamation to Song demanding Tuozhou’s head in exchange for the old Huainan territories.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Wanyan Kuang to notify Song that Tuozhou’s head must be sent before the former Huainan lands would be restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅朔，《遼史》成。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renyin new moon, the Liao History was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin new moon, the Liao History was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以符寶郎烏古論福齡為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Talisman Officer Wugulun Fuling was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Talisman Officer Wugulun Fuling was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔策論進士免試弓箭、擊球。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict exempted policy-essay jinshi from the archery and cuju tests.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu policy-essay jinshi were excused from the archery and cuju examinations.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以尚書右丞孫即康為左丞，參知政事獨吉思忠為右丞，中都路都轉運使孫鐸為參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengshen Right Vice Director Sun Jikang was made left vice director; Participation Councillor Dusigizhong was made right vice director; and Central Capital Route chief transport commissioner Sun Tuo was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Right Vice Director Sun Jikang became left vice director, Participation Councillor Dusigizhong right vice director, and Central Capital Route Chief Transport Commissioner Sun Tuo participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛未朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year eight, spring, first month, on xinwei new moon, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year eight, on the xinwei new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys came from Goryeo and Xia.

sentences.zh: 壬申，朝謁于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On renshen he performed court audience at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he attended court at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，收毀大鈔，行小鈔。

translations.literal: On guiyou large notes were collected and destroyed and small notes were put in circulation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou large paper notes were recalled and destroyed and small notes were issued.

sentences.zh: 以元帥左都監完顏撒剌為參知政事。

translations.literal: Marshal Left Inspector Wanyan Sala was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Left Inspector Wanyan Sala was appointed participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宋安丙遣兵襲鶻嶺關，副統把回海、完顏摑剌擊走之，斬其將景統領。

translations.literal: On yihai Song’s An Bing sent troops to raid Geling Pass; Deputy Commander Ba Wanghai and Wanyan Wola drove them off and beheaded their general Commander Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Song’s An Bing raided Geling Pass; Deputy Commanders Ba Wanghai and Wanyan Wola repulsed them and killed their general, Commander Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，左司郎中劉昂、通州刺史史肅、監察禦史王宇、吏部主事曹元、吏部員外郎徒單永康、太倉使馬良顯、順州刺史唐括直思白坐與蒲陰令大中私議朝政，皆杖之。

translations.literal: On bingzi Left Office Director Liu Ang, Tongzhou prefect Shi Su, investigating censor Wang Yu, Ministry of Personnel clerk Cao Yuan, Ministry of Personnel vice director Tudan Yongkang, Grand Granary commissioner Ma Liangxian, and Shunzhou prefect Tangguo Zhisi, for privately discussing court affairs with Puyin magistrate Dazhong, were all flogged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Liu Ang, director of the Left Office, Tongzhou Prefect Shi Su, Investigating Censor Wang Yu, Ministry of Personnel Clerk Cao Yuan, Ministry Vice Director Tudan Yongkang, Grand Granary Commissioner Ma Liangxian, and Shunzhou Prefect Tangguo Zhisi were flogged for privately debating policy with Puyin Magistrate Dazhong.

sentences.zh: 癸未，如春水。

translations.literal: On guiwei he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，如光春宮。

translations.literal: On bingxu he went to Guangchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he went to Guangchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，宋參知政事錢象祖遣王柟來，以書上行省，複請川、陝關隘。

translations.literal: Second month, on yisi Song Participation Councillor Qian Xiangzu sent Wang Song, who came with a letter to the Route Secretariat again requesting the passes of Chuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Song Participation Councillor Qian Xiangzu sent Wang Song with a letter to the route secretariat again asking for the Sichuan and Shaanxi passes.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin he went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諭有司曰：「方農作時，雖在禁地亦令耕種。

translations.literal: On gengshen he instructed the officials: "At the season of planting, even in forbidden ground let them cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he told the officials, "During planting season, even in forbidden ground they may farm.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，還宮。

translations.literal: ” On jisi he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: ” On jisi he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛未，諭尚書省曰：「翰林侍請學士蒲察畏也言，使宋官當選人，其言甚當。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on xinwei, he instructed the Secretariat: "Hanlin Attendant Invitation Academician Pucha Wuye said that Song officials should be chosen from among those who have passed selection — his words are very apt.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinwei, he told the Secretariat, "Hanlin attendant-invitation academician Pucha Wuye said Song envoys ought to be drawn from men who have passed selection — he is quite right.

sentences.zh: 彼通謝使雖未到闕，其報聘人當行議擇。

translations.literal: Although their peace-thanks envoy has not yet reached court, the return-embassy personnel should be chosen by deliberation now.
translations.idiomatic: Even though Song’s peace-thanks envoy has not yet arrived, their return embassy should be chosen now by deliberation.

sentences.zh: 此乃更始，凡有禮數，皆在奉使。

translations.literal: This is a fresh beginning; all ceremonial points lie with the embassy.
translations.idiomatic: This is a new start: every point of ceremony rests with the envoys.

sentences.zh: 今既行之，遂為永例，不可不慎也。

translations.literal: Now that it is being done, it will become a permanent precedent — you must not be careless."
translations.idiomatic: Once we set the practice, it becomes a standing rule — take care."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，制諸州府司縣造作，不得役諸色人匠。

translations.literal: ” On jiaxu a statute was made that in all prefectures, circuits, and counties construction must not press artisans of every category into service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict forbade prefectures, circuits, and counties from pressing artisans of every category into construction work.

sentences.zh: 違者准私役之律，計備以受所監臨財物論。

translations.literal: Violators were judged by the statute on private corvée, with the cost of replacement labor counted as receiving goods under supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Violators were punished under the law on private corvée, with replacement costs assessed as taking bribes from those supervised.

sentences.zh: 甲申，定承應人收補年甲格。

translations.literal: On jiashen standards were set for the ages at which palace attendants might be recruited and enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen age standards were fixed for recruiting and enrolling palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 甲午，雨雹。

translations.literal: On jiawu hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu hail fell.

sentences.zh: 定保甲軍殺獲南軍官賞。

translations.literal: Rewards were set for baojia militia who killed or captured Southern army officers.
translations.idiomatic: Bounties were fixed for baojia militia who killed or captured Song officers.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宋獻韓侂胄等首于元帥府。

translations.literal: On yiwei Song presented the heads of Han Tuozhou and others to the Marshal’s Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Song delivered the heads of Han Tuozhou and others to the Marshal’s Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，禦應天門，備橫麾立杖，親王文武合班起居。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingwei, he took the throne at the Responding-to-Heaven Gate with horizontal banners and standing halberds displayed; princes and civil and military officials formed combined ranks for the greeting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei, he held court at the Responding-to-Heaven Gate with horizontal banners and standing halberds; princes and the civil and military officials bowed in combined ranks.

sentences.zh: 中路兵馬提控、平南撫軍上將軍紇石烈貞以宋賊臣韓侂胄、蘇師旦首獻，並奉元帥府露布以聞。

translations.literal: Central Route military controller and Pacify-the-South commissioner-general Heshilie Zhen presented the heads of Song traitor-ministers Han Tuozhou and Su Shidan and submitted the Marshal’s Headquarters victory bulletin to inform the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Central Route Military Controller and Pacify-the-South Commissioner-General Heshilie Zhen presented the heads of Song traitor-ministers Han Tuozhou and Su Shidan and reported with the Marshal’s Headquarters victory bulletin.

sentences.zh: 懸其首並畫像於市，以露布頒中外。

translations.literal: Their heads and painted likenesses were hung in the market, and the bulletin was promulgated at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Their heads and portraits were displayed in the market, and the bulletin was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，平章政事匡至自軍。

translations.literal: On bingchen Grand Councillor Kuang returned from the army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Grand Councillor Kuang returned from campaign.

sentences.zh: 己未，更元帥府為樞密院。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Marshal’s Headquarters was renamed the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Marshal’s Headquarters became the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔移天壽節於十月十五日。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict moved the Heavenly Longevity Festival to the fifteenth day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Heavenly Longevity Festival was moved to the fifteenth of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣使分路捕蝗。

translations.literal: On dingmao envoys were sent on separate routes to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao envoys were dispatched on separate routes to hunt locusts.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，宋通謝使朝議大夫、試禮部尚書許奕，福州觀察使、右武衛上將軍吳衡等奉其主書入見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on guiyou, Song peace-thanks envoy Palace Gentleman for Court Discussion and acting Minister of Rites Xu Yi, Fuzhou observation commissioner and Right Martial Guard general Wu Heng, and others presented their sovereign’s letter in audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, Song’s peace-thanks envoys — Palace Gentleman for Court Discussion and acting Minister of Rites Xu Yi, Fuzhou Observation Commissioner and Right Martial Guard General Wu Heng, and others — presented their ruler’s letter in audience.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，謁謝于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu thanksgiving was offered at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he offered thanks at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以許宋平，詔中外。

translations.literal: On guiwei, because peace with Song was granted, an edict was issued at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, with peace granted to Song, an edict went out to the realm.

sentences.zh: 免河南、山東、陝西等六路今年夏稅，河東、河北、大名等五路半之。

translations.literal: This year’s summer tax was remitted in the six circuits of Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, and the rest; in the five circuits of Hedong, Hebei, Daming, and the rest it was halved.
translations.idiomatic: Summer tax for the year was waived in Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, and the other six circuits, and cut by half in Hedong, Hebei, Daming, and the other five.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以元帥左都監烏古論誼為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On dinghai Marshal Left Inspector Ugulun Yi was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Marshal Left Inspector Ugulun Yi became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，飛蝗入京畿。

translations.literal: On wuzi flying locusts entered the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi locust swarms entered the capital region.

sentences.zh: 乙未，定服飾明金象金制。

translations.literal: On yiwei regulations were set for bright gold and elephant gold on dress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei rules were fixed for bright gold and elephant gold on official dress.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以左副都點檢完顏侃為宋諭成使，禮部侍郎喬宇副之。

translations.literal: On dingyou Left Deputy Director of Palace Attendants Wanyan Kan was made Song settlement envoy, with Vice Minister of Rites Qiao Yu as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Left Deputy Director of Palace Attendants Wanyan Kan was sent as envoy to announce the settlement with Song, with Vice Minister of Rites Qiao Yu as deputy.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on wuxu: Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the wuxu new moon, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔更定蝗蟲生髮坐罪法。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict revised the penal law for allowing locusts to breed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the law punishing failure to control locust breeding was revised.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On yisi court offering was made at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he offered court sacrifice at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔頒《捕蝗圖》於中外。

translations.literal: An edict promulgated the Catch-Locust Diagram at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: An edict issued the Catch-Locust Diagram throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宋使朝辭，致答通謝書及誓書于宋主。

translations.literal: On wushen the Song envoys took leave of audience and delivered the reply to the peace-thanks letter and the oath document to the Song ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Song envoys were received in farewell audience and carried back the reply to the peace-thanks letter and the oath text for their ruler.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，更定遼東行使鈔法。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renshen, the paper-note law for the Liaodong Route was revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renshen, Liaodong Route paper-note regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On guiyou he went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以戶部尚書高汝礪等為宋生日使。

translations.literal: On jichou Minister of Revenue Gao Rulü and others were made Song birthday envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Minister of Revenue Gao Rulü and others were sent as Song birthday envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，如秋山。

translations.literal: On gengyin he went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，遣吏部尚書賈守謙等一十三人與各路按察司官推排民戶物力。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiazi, Minister of Personnel Jia Shouqian and twelve others were sent with surveillance commissioners of each route to reassess civilian household property liability.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Minister of Personnel Jia Shouqian and twelve others were dispatched with each route’s surveillance commissioner to reassess household property assessments.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至自秋山。

translations.literal: On yichou he returned from Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he returned from Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，以吏部郎中郭郛為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei, Ministry of Personnel director Guo Ye was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on xinwei, Ministry of Personnel Director Guo Ye was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On xinsi Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi congratulatory envoys arrived from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 夏國有兵，遣使來告。

translations.literal: Western Xia had troops in the field and sent envoys to report it.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia was at war and sent envoys to inform the court.

sentences.zh: 癸未，更定安泊強竊盜罪格。

translations.literal: On guiwei standards were revised for the crimes of harboring and violent or stealth theft.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei penalties were revised for harboring thieves and for robbery and burglary.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以軍民共譽為廉能官條附善最法。

translations.literal: On xinmao a provision was added to the law of best evaluations that officials praised alike by soldiers and civilians counted as incorrupt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the law of best annual evaluations was amended so that officials praised by both soldiers and civilians ranked as incorrupt.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：章宗在位二十年，承世宗治平日久，宇內小康，乃正禮樂，修刑法，定官制，典章文物粲然成一代治規。

translations.literal: Comment: Zhangzong reigned twenty years, inheriting Shizong’s long peace until the realm knew modest prosperity; then he set rites and music in order, revised penal law, fixed the bureaucracy, until institutions and cultural models shone as one generation’s code of rule.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Zhangzong ruled twenty years on Shizong’s long peace until the realm enjoyed modest ease; he ordered ritual and music, revised the penal code, and fixed offices until institutions and cultural models formed a generation’s pattern of governance.

sentences.zh: 又數問群臣漢宣綜核名實、唐代考課之法，蓋欲跨遼、宋而比跡于漢、唐，亦可謂有志於治者矣！

translations.literal: Again and again he asked his ministers about Han Xuandi’s scrutiny of names and realities and the Tang method of performance review — he wished to stride past Liao and Song and rank with Han and Tang; he may be called a ruler with the will to govern!
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly questioned his ministers on Han Xuandi’s matching of names to realities and the Tang performance-review system — aiming to outdo Liao and Song and stand beside Han and Tang; one may call him a ruler with the will to govern.

sentences.zh: 然婢寵擅朝，塚嗣未立，疏忌宗室而傳授非人。

translations.literal: Yet a favorite usurped court power, the heir was not established, the imperial clan was feared and sidelined, and the succession was given to the wrong man.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a concubine favorite dominated the court, no heir was named, the imperial clan was distrusted, and the throne passed to the wrong man.

sentences.zh: 向之所謂維持鞏固於久遠者，徒為文具，而不得為後世子孫一日之用，金源氏從此衰矣！

translations.literal: What he had called securing the dynasty for the long term proved mere paperwork, useless even for his descendants for a single day — from this the house of the Golden Source began to decline!
translations.idiomatic: What he had called securing the dynasty for ages proved empty forms, good not even for his descendants for one day — from this the Jin house began to fall.

sentences.zh: 昔揚雄氏有雲：「秦之有司負秦之法度，秦之法度負聖人之法度。

translations.literal: Long ago Yang Xiong said: "The functionaries of Qin leaned on Qin’s statutes, and Qin’s statutes leaned on the sages’ statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Yang Xiong wrote: "Qin’s functionaries leaned on Qin’s statutes, and Qin’s statutes leaned on the sages’ statutes.

sentences.zh: 」蓋有以夫。

translations.literal: ” There was indeed reason in this.
translations.idiomatic: ” He had point indeed.
